        case OP_LG2: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "log2((%s).x)", a); break;
        /* RSX fragment programs also expose the vertex-style LIT helper and
         * its SFL/STR constants. RPCS3's GLSL helper clamps y before log2 so
         * the specified pow(x, 0) case stays finite. */
        case OP_LIT:
            snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                     "float4(1.0, max((%s).x, 0.0), ((%s).x > 0.0) ? "
                     "exp2((%s).w * log2(max((%s).y, 1e-10))) : 0.0, 1.0)",
                     a, a, a, a);
            break;
        case OP_STR: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "(float4)1.0"); break;
        case OP_SFL: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "(float4)0.0"); break;
        case OP_COS: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "cos((%s).x)", a); break;
        case OP_SIN: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "sin((%s).x)", a); break;
        case OP_POW: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "pow((%s).x, (%s).x)", a, b); break;
        case OP_DIV: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "(%s) / (%s).x", a, b); break;
        /* Real RSX DIVSQ shares RSQ's sign-ignoring sqrt on the denominator
         * (oracle: RPCS3 FragmentProgramDecompiler.cpp's _builtin_sqrt macro,
         * reused by _builtin_divsq) AND forces the result to exactly 0,
         * component-wise, wherever the NUMERATOR component is 0 -- even if
         * the denominator is also 0 (oracle: same file, "DIVSQ is not
         * compliant. Result is 0 if numerator is 0 regardless of
         * denominator", FragmentProgramDecompiler.cpp:1076). Using a true
         * per-component select (HLSL vector `?:`, not lerp/mix) avoids NaN
         * contamination from the 0/0 branch, matching the oracle's own note
         * on why it can't use a blend here. */
        case OP_DIVSQ:
            snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                     "(abs(%s) > 0.0 ? (%s) / sqrt(abs((%s).x)) : (float4)0.0)",
                     a, a, b);
            break;
        case OP_DP2: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "dot((%s).xy, (%s).xy)", a, b); break;
        case OP_REFL: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "reflect((%s), (%s))", a, b); break;
        case OP_DDX: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "ddx((%s))", a); break;
        case OP_DDY: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "ddy((%s))", a); break;
        case OP_PKG:
            fp_helper_mask |= 1u;
            snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "asfloat(_rsx_pack_unorm4x8(_rsx_linear_to_srgb(%s)))", a);
            break;
        case OP_UPG:
            fp_helper_mask |= 1u;
            snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "_rsx_srgb_to_linear(_rsx_unpack_unorm4x8((%s).x))", a);
            break;
        case OP_NRM: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "float4(normalize((%s).xyz), 1.0)", a); break;
        case OP_LRP: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "lerp((%s), (%s), (%s))", c, b, a); break;
        /* Lighting coefficients: (1, y, y > 0 ? 2^w : 0, 1) (RPCS3
         * FragmentProgramDecompiler, RSX_FP_OPCODE_LIF). */
        case OP_LIF:
            snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                     "float4(1.0, (%s).y, (%s).y > 0.0 ? exp2((%s).w) : 0.0, 1.0)", a, a, a);
            break;
        /* Texture/branch fences: ordering hints with no result -- no-op. */
        case OP_FENCT: case OP_FENCB: rhs[0] = '\0'; handled = 0; break;
        case OP_SLT: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "(float4)((%s) <  (%s))", a, b); break;
        case OP_SGE: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "(float4)((%s) >= (%s))", a, b); break;
        case OP_SLE: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "(float4)((%s) <= (%s))", a, b); break;
        case OP_SGT: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "(float4)((%s) >  (%s))", a, b); break;
        case OP_SNE: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "(float4)((%s) != (%s))", a, b); break;
        case OP_SEQ: snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "(float4)((%s) == (%s))", a, b); break;
        case OP_TEX:
            if (shadow && shadow[tex_unit].enabled) {
                snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "_rsx_shadow%u((%s).xyz)", tex_unit, a);
                break;
            }
            if ((tex_shadow_mask >> tex_unit) & 1u) {
                /* RSX depth textures use the coordinate's Z as the reference
                 * value. D3D comparison filtering compares reference against
                 * stored depth; the root-signature sampler is specialized to
                 * the guest ZFUNC for this texture unit. */
                if (tex_sep_mask)
                    snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                             "rsx_tex%u.SampleCmp(rsx_shadow_samp[%u], (%s).xy, (%s).z).xxxx",
                             tex_unit, tex_unit, a, a);
                else
                    snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                             "rsx_tex[%u].SampleCmp(rsx_shadow_samp[%u], (%s).xy, (%s).z).xxxx",
                             tex_unit, tex_unit, a, a);
            } else if ((tex_sep_mask >> tex_unit) & 1u)
                /* Cubemap or volume: sample with all three coordinates. */
                snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                         "rsx_tex%u.Sample(rsx_samp[%u], (%s).xyz)", tex_unit, tex_unit, a);
            else if (tex_sep_mask)
                snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                         "rsx_tex%u.Sample(rsx_samp[%u], (%s).xy)", tex_unit, tex_unit, a);
            else
                snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                         "rsx_tex[%u].Sample(rsx_samp[%u], (%s).xy)", tex_unit, tex_unit, a);
            break;
        case OP_TXD: {
            /* TXD uses SRC0 as coordinates and SRC1/SRC2 as explicit X/Y
             * gradients. HLSL SampleGrad expects gradients in the sampled
             * texture's coordinate dimension (2D or cubemap here). */
            const int cube = (tex_cube_mask >> tex_unit) & 1u;
            char tn[32];
            snprintf(tn, sizeof(tn), tex_cube_mask ? "rsx_tex%u" : "rsx_tex[%u]", tex_unit);
            const char* dims = cube ? "xyz" : "xy";
            snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                     "%s.SampleGrad(rsx_samp[%u], (%s).%s, (%s).%s, (%s).%s)",
                     tn, tex_unit, a, dims, b, dims, c, dims);
            break;
        }
        case OP_TXP:
            if (shadow && shadow[tex_unit].enabled) {
                snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "_rsx_shadow%u((%s).xyz / (%s).w)", tex_unit, a, a);
                break;
            }
            if ((tex_cube_mask >> tex_unit) & 1u)
                /* Projective divide is meaningless for a cube lookup; sample
                 * the direction directly. */
                snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                         "rsx_tex%u.Sample(rsx_samp[%u], (%s).xyz)", tex_unit, tex_unit, a);
            else if ((tex_vol_mask >> tex_unit) & 1u)
                snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                         "rsx_tex%u.Sample(rsx_samp[%u], (%s).xyz / (%s).w)",
                         tex_unit, tex_unit, a, a);
            else if (tex_sep_mask)
                snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                         "rsx_tex%u.Sample(rsx_samp[%u], (%s).xy / (%s).w)",
                         tex_unit, tex_unit, a, a);
            else
                snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                         "rsx_tex[%u].Sample(rsx_samp[%u], (%s).xy / (%s).w)",
                         tex_unit, tex_unit, a, a);
            break;
        case OP_TXB: case OP_TXL: {
            /* Biased / explicit-LOD sample; bias or LOD is src1.x (RPCS3
             * TEXTURE_SAMPLE2D_BIAS / _LOD). GH3's fret buttons and fret lines
             * are TXB: unhandled, they sampled nothing and output alpha 0. */
            const int cube = (tex_sep_mask >> tex_unit) & 1u;   /* cube or volume: xyz */
            char tn[32];
            snprintf(tn, sizeof(tn), tex_sep_mask ? "rsx_tex%u" : "rsx_tex[%u]", tex_unit);
            snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "%s.%s(rsx_samp[%u], (%s).%s, (%s).x)", tn,
                     opcode == OP_TXB ? "SampleBias" : "SampleLevel", tex_unit, a,
                     cube ? "xyz" : "xy", b);
            break;
        }
        case OP_BEM: {
            /* Bump-environment coordinate transform (RPCS3's independently
             * verified vector formula): base.xy plus the two bump-vector
             * products, duplicated into xy/zw pairs. */
            snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs),
                     "(%s).xyxy + (%s).xxxx * (%s).xzxz + (%s).yyyy * (%s).ywyw",
                     a, b, c, b, c);
            break;
        }
        case OP_TEXBEM: case OP_TXPBEM: {
            /* TEXBEM/TXPBEM apply the same BEM transform to the texture
             * coordinate before sampling. Keeping the transform inline avoids
             * introducing a temporary whose lifetime crosses predication. */
            const int cube = (tex_cube_mask >> tex_unit) & 1u;
            char tn[32], coord[1100];
            snprintf(tn, sizeof(tn), tex_cube_mask ? "rsx_tex%u" : "rsx_tex[%u]", tex_unit);
            snprintf(coord, sizeof(coord),
                     "((%s).xyxy + (%s).xxxx * (%s).xzxz + (%s).yyyy * (%s).ywyw)",
                     a, b, c, b, c);
            if (cube) {
                snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "%s.Sample(rsx_samp[%u], (%s).xyz)",
                         tn, tex_unit, coord);
            } else if (opcode == OP_TXPBEM) {
                snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "%s.Sample(rsx_samp[%u], (%s).xy / (%s).w)",
                         tn, tex_unit, coord, coord);
            } else {
                snprintf(rhs, sizeof(rhs), "%s.Sample(rsx_samp[%u], (%s).xy)",
                         tn, tex_unit, coord);
            }
            break;
        }
        case OP_KIL:
            /* Fragment kill. Predicated by the same exec_if condition as any
             * other instruction (RPCS3 FragmentProgramDecompiler case
             * RSX_FP_OPCODE_KIL: AddFlowOp("discard") under GetCond());
             * unconditional encodings discard outright. Dropping this (the
             * old TODO) rendered every alpha-cutout material as a solid
             * quad. */
            if (is_never) {
                rhs[0] = '\0';
            } else if (is_uncond) {
                out_puts(&o, "    discard;\n");
            } else {
                char kil[128];
                snprintf(kil, sizeof(kil),
                         "    if (any(cc%u.%s %s (float4)0)) discard;\n",
                         cc_read, cswz, cmp_op);
                out_puts(&o, kil);
            }
            handled = 0;   /* no destination write */
            break;
        default: {
            /* The number and the raw words, so an opcode outside the table
             * can be identified from the dumped shader alone. */
            char todo[160];
            snprintf(todo, sizeof todo,
                     "    /* TODO: unhandled FP opcode 0x%02X (%s) words %08X %08X %08X %08X */\n",
                     opcode, rsx_fp_opcode_name(opcode), w0, w1, w2, w3);
            out_puts(&o, todo);
            FP_MARK_UNSUPPORTED(opcode);
            handled = 0;
            break; }
            break;
        }

        if (gamma_masks && gamma_masks[tex_unit] && !(w0 & (1u << 21)) &&
            (opcode == OP_TEX || opcode == OP_TXP || opcode == OP_TXB || opcode == OP_TXL)) {
            char sample[sizeof rhs]; memcpy(sample, rhs, sizeof sample);
            const int length = snprintf(rhs, sizeof rhs, "_rsx_gamma_input(%s, %uu)",
                                        sample, gamma_masks[tex_unit] & 15u);
            if (length < 0 || (size_t)length >= sizeof rhs) return -1;
        }
        /* Texture sign expansion (RPCS3 _process_texel). A unit whose
         * SET_TEXTURE_ADDRESS asks for UNSIGNED_REMAP_BIASED returns every
         * fetch re-centred on the lanes the mask names, (round(x*255)-128)/127
         * (16-bit channels: /32767), after gamma and not on gamma lanes. A
         * fetch carrying EXP_TEX (OPDEST bit 21, the _bx2 modifier) returns
         * x*2-1 on every lane, whatever the unit says, and bypasses gamma.
         * A comparison fetch has nothing to expand. */
        if (((w0 & (1u << 21)) || (expand_masks && expand_masks[tex_unit])) &&
            !(shadow && shadow[tex_unit].enabled) &&
            (opcode == OP_TEX || opcode == OP_TXP || opcode == OP_TXB || opcode == OP_TXL)) {
            const int bx2 = (w0 & (1u << 21)) != 0;
            u32 mask = bx2 ? 15u : (expand_masks[tex_unit] & 0x1Fu);
            if (!bx2 && gamma_masks) mask &= ~(gamma_masks[tex_unit] & 15u);
            if (mask & 15u) {
                char sample[sizeof rhs]; memcpy(sample, rhs, sizeof sample);
                const int length = snprintf(rhs, sizeof rhs, "_rsx_expand_input(%s, %uu, %s)",
                                            sample, mask, bx2 ? "true" : "false");
                if (length < 0 || (size_t)length >= sizeof rhs) return -1;
            }
        } else if (((w0 & (1u << 21)) || (expand_masks && expand_masks[tex_unit])) &&
                   (opcode == OP_TXD || opcode == OP_TEXBEM || opcode == OP_TXPBEM)) {
            static u32 reported;
            if (PS3_LOG_FIRST(reported, 32))
                fprintf(stderr, "[RSX fp] sign-expand fetch opcode %u unsupported on unit %u (read unexpanded)\n",
                        opcode, tex_unit);
        }

        int has_dest = !(w0 & FP_OUT_NONE);
        if (dbg_here && handled && !dbg_done) dbg_count++;
        if (handled && (has_dest || set_cond)) {
            u32 dst_idx = (w0 & FP_OUT_REG_MASK) >> FP_OUT_REG_SHIFT;
            int dst_half = (w0 & FP_OUT_HALF) ? 1 : 0;
            const char* reg = dst_half ? "h" : "r";
            char m[5];
            dest_mask(w0, m);

            const char* sat = (w0 & FP_OUT_SAT) ? " _v = saturate(_v);" : "";
            /* OPDEST.exp_tex/prec are per-instruction result handling, not
             * register precision. RPCS3's July 2017 P5 fix restored these
             * modifiers: _bx2 expands [0,1] to [-1,1], while precision 1
             * clamps to FP16's finite range and precision 2 to FX12 [-2,2].
             * Apply after the result scale and before _sat, matching its
             * SetDst -> NoOverflow -> saturate order. */
            const u32 dst_prec = (w0 & FP_OUT_PREC_MASK) >> FP_OUT_PREC_SHIFT;
            const char* result_range = "";
            if (w0 & FP_OUT_EXP_TEX)
                result_range = " _v = (_v - (float4)0.5) * 2.0;";
            else if (dst_prec == 1u)
                result_range = " _v = clamp(_v, (float4)-65504.0, (float4)65504.0);";
            else if (dst_prec == 2u)
                result_range = " _v = clamp(_v, (float4)-2.0, (float4)2.0);";
            /* NV40 per-instruction result-scale modifier (SRC1 word bits
             * 28-30): 1/2/3 = *2/*4/*8, 5/6/7 = /2//4//8; applied to the
             * result BEFORE saturate (RPCS3 FragmentProgramDecompiler.cpp
             * SetDst, RSXFragmentProgram.h SRC1.scale:3). Dropped entirely
             * until s32: draw 1625's two-tap box filter (÷2 on the final
             * ADD) summed unaveraged -- the flat 2x composite gain behind
             * the whiteout/overbright class (scratch/s32_gain_hunt.md). */
            u32 res_scale = (w2 >> 28) & 0x7u;
            static const char* scale_txt[8] = { "", " * 2.0", " * 4.0", " * 8.0",
                                                "", " / 2.0", " / 4.0", " / 8.0" };

            /* Broadcast the result to float4 first so the write-mask picks the
             * CORRESPONDING components: `dst.w = rhs` would HLSL-truncate a
             * vector rhs to its .x, but NV40 writes rhs.w to dst.w. Scalar
             * results (DPx/RCP/...) replicate, which is also the hardware
             * behavior. */
            if (has_dest && is_uncond && !set_cond) {
                /* Common unconditional path — kept byte-identical so the 39
                 * non-predicated programs in this capture emit unchanged. */
                char line[2200];
                snprintf(line, sizeof(line),
                         "    { float4 _v = (float4)(%s)%s;%s%s %s[%u].%s = _v.%s; }\n",
                         rhs, scale_txt[res_scale], result_range, sat,
                         reg, dst_idx, m, m);
                out_puts(&o, line);
            } else {
                /* Predicated and/or CC-writing instruction. */
                char buf[2800];
                snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
                         "    { float4 _v = (float4)(%s)%s;%s%s\n",
                         rhs, scale_txt[res_scale], result_range, sat);
                out_puts(&o, buf);
                if (has_dest) {
                    if (is_uncond) {
                        snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
                                 "      %s[%u].%s = _v.%s;\n", reg, dst_idx, m, m);
                    } else if (is_never) {
                        snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
                                 "      /* exec_if=none: write suppressed */\n");
                    } else {
                        /* Per-component select gated by the CC sign test.
                         * A real select, not lerp(dst, _v, mask): lerp is
                         * arithmetic (dst + mask * (_v - dst)), so an Inf or
                         * NaN in the unselected operand poisons the result
                         * (0 * Inf = NaN), and a register holding raw bits
                         * (a packed word) loses its denormal and NaN
                         * patterns on the way through the ALU. */
                        snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
                                 "      float4 _p = (float4)((cc%u).%s %s (float4)0.0);\n"
                                 "      %s[%u].%s = (_p.%s != 0.0) ? _v.%s : %s[%u].%s;\n",
                                 cc_read, cswz, cmp_op,
                                 reg, dst_idx, m, m, m, reg, dst_idx, m);
                    }
                    out_puts(&o, buf);
                }
                if (set_cond) {
                    /* CC receives the destination value (post-select), masked;
                     * for no-dest set_cond it receives the raw result. */
                    if (has_dest)
                        snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
                                 "      cc%u.%s = %s[%u].%s;\n", cc_write, m, reg, dst_idx, m);
                    else
                        snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
                                 "      cc%u.%s = _v.%s;\n", cc_write, m, m);
                    out_puts(&o, buf);
                }
                out_puts(&o, "    }\n");
            }

            if (has_dest) {
                const int target = fp_export_target(dst_idx, dst_half);
                if (target >= 0) wrote[dst_half][target] = 1;
            }
        }

        if (w0 & FP_END) break;
    }
    /* A block whose end address is at or past END never saw it: close it. */
    while (n_blk-- > 0)
        out_puts(&o, "    }\n");

    if (unsupported_count) {
        static u32 warnings;
        if (warnings++ < 32)
            fprintf(stderr,
                    "[RSX fp] rejected partial translation: %u unsupported op(s), first +0x%X opcode=0x%02X\n",
                    unsupported_count, unsupported_off, unsupported_opcode);
        return -1;
    }
#undef FP_MARK_UNSUPPORTED

    /* Fragment color output register selection. The NV40 hardware picks the
     * output from the SHADER_CONTROL word's 32_BITS_EXPORTS bit, not from
     * whichever temp happened to be written: fp32-export programs output r0,
     * fp16-export programs (the default) output h0 (RPCS3
     * FragmentProgramDecompiler::BuildCode). Many real material/lighting
     * shaders accumulate into fp32 temps (r2/r3/r4) but write their FINAL
     * color to h0 — the old "wrote_r0 => return r0" heuristic returned a stale
     * intermediate, producing flat/constant surfaces. */
    int half_exports;
    if (ctrl == RSX_FP_CTRL_AUTO) {
        /* No control word (standalone tests): legacy heuristic. */
        half_exports = (wrote[0][0] || !wrote[1][0]) ? 0 : 1;
    } else {
        half_exports = (ctrl & FP_CTRL_32BIT_EXPORTS) ? 0 : 1;
    }
    const char* export_file = half_exports ? "h" : "r";

    /* How many colour targets the program feeds: one past the highest export
     * register of the selected file it wrote. A program that writes only the
     * first keeps the single-value return it has always had, byte for byte;
     * only a program that reaches the second, third or fourth grows a struct.
     * Writes to the OTHER file's export registers do not count -- r2/r3/r4 are
     * ordinary temps under 16-bit exports, and accumulating into them while
     * the colour goes to h0 is what most material shaders do. */
    u32 targets = 1;
    for (u32 t = FP_MAX_COLOR_TARGETS; t-- > 1; )
        if (wrote[half_exports][t]) { targets = t + 1; break; }
    const int depth_export = ctrl != RSX_FP_CTRL_AUTO && (ctrl & 0xEu) != 0u;
    if (dbg_here) {
        static u32 reported;
        if (PS3_LOG_FIRST(reported, 8))
            fprintf(stderr, "[RSX fp] RSX_FP_DEBUG %016llx: %s after instruction %ld%s\n",
                    (unsigned long long)dbg_hash, dbg_reg, dbg_n,
                    dbg_done ? "" : " not reached (program is shorter)");
        if (dbg_done)
            out_puts(&o, "    { float4 _d = _rsx_dbg; _d.w = 1.0;"
                         " r[0] = _d; h[0] = _d; }\n");
    }

    /* Resolve RET markers after the output register file and MRT return type
     * are known. RPCS3's fragment CFG treats RET as an early shader return;
     * each generated return reads the output registers at that point. */
    for (u32 i = 0; i < ret_count; i++) {
        char token[48], action[2048];
        snprintf(token, sizeof token, "/*RSX_FP_RET_%u*/", i);
        size_t action_len = 0;
        int n;
        if (targets == 1 && !depth_export) {
            n = snprintf(action, sizeof action,
                         "float4 _ret = %s[0]; return (_ret == _ret) ? _ret : (float4)0;",
                         export_file);
            if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof action) return -1;
            action_len = (size_t)n;
        } else {
            n = snprintf(action, sizeof action, "PSOutput _ret;\n");
            if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof action) return -1;
            action_len = (size_t)n;
            for (u32 t = 0; t < targets; t++) {
                n = snprintf(action + action_len, sizeof action - action_len,
                             "float4 _ret_color%u = %s[%u]; _ret.t%u = (_ret_color%u == _ret_color%u) ? _ret_color%u : (float4)0;\n",
                             t, export_file, fp_export_reg[half_exports][t],
                             t, t, t, t);
                if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof action - action_len) return -1;
                action_len += (size_t)n;
            }
            if (depth_export) {
                n = snprintf(action + action_len, sizeof action - action_len,
                             "float _ret_depth = r[1].z; _ret.depth = (_ret_depth == _ret_depth) ? saturate(_ret_depth) : 0.0;\n");
                if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof action - action_len) return -1;
                action_len += (size_t)n;
            }
            n = snprintf(action + action_len, sizeof action - action_len, "return _ret;");
            if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof action - action_len) return -1;
        }
        if (out_replace_token(&o, token, action) < 0) return -1;
    }
    if (targets == 1 && !depth_export) {
        char tail[96];
        snprintf(tail, sizeof(tail),
                 "    float4 _o = %s[0];\n"
                 "    return (_o == _o) ? _o : (float4)0;\n}\n", export_file);
        out_puts(&o, tail);
    } else {
        /* Multiple render targets. The NaN guard is per target: a poisoned
         * G-buffer plane is as fatal as a poisoned colour one, and the planes
         * are computed independently. */
        out_puts(&o, "    PSOutput _out;\n");
        for (u32 t = 0; t < targets; t++) {
            char line[192];
            snprintf(line, sizeof(line),
                     "    float4 _o%u = %s[%u];\n"
                     "    _out.t%u = (_o%u == _o%u) ? _o%u : (float4)0;\n",
                     t, export_file, fp_export_reg[half_exports][t],
                     t, t, t, t);
            out_puts(&o, line);
        }
        if (depth_export)
            out_puts(&o, "    float _d = r[1].z;\n"
                         "    _out.depth = (_d == _d) ? saturate(_d) : 0.0;\n");
        out_puts(&o, "    return _out;\n}\n");
    }

    /* Preamble: PSInput matches the backend's placeholder layout; temp/half
     * register files; texture+sampler banks for TEX. Built here, in front of
     * the body, now that the return type is known. */
    char preamble[32768];
    Out p = { preamble, sizeof(preamble), 0, 1 };
    preamble[0] = '\0';
    out_puts(&p,
        "struct PSInput {\n"
        "    float4 position : SV_POSITION; float4 col0 : COLOR0; float4 col1 : COLOR1;\n"
        "    float4 col2 : COLOR2; float4 col3 : COLOR3; float4 fog : FOG;\n"
        "    float4 tc0:TEXCOORD0; float4 tc1:TEXCOORD1; float4 tc2:TEXCOORD2; float4 tc3:TEXCOORD3;\n"
        "    float4 tc4:TEXCOORD4; float4 tc5:TEXCOORD5; float4 tc6:TEXCOORD6; float4 tc7:TEXCOORD7;\n");
    /* TC8/TC9 and the face flag only where the body reads them, so every other
     * program stays byte-identical (and keeps its cached pipeline). TC8 and
     * TC9 follow TC7 so the earlier interpolants keep their locations. */
    if (strstr(o.p, "input.tc8") || strstr(o.p, "input.tc9"))
        out_puts(&p, "    float4 tc8:TEXCOORD8; float4 tc9:TEXCOORD9;\n");
    if (strstr(o.p, "input._rsx_front"))
        out_puts(&p, "    bool _rsx_front : SV_IsFrontFace;\n");
    out_puts(&p, "};\n");
    /* 1/w of the fragment for perspective_corr reads. SV_POSITION.w is the
     * clip w under FXC (D3D12) but already 1/w once glslang lowers it to
     * SPIR-V FragCoord (Vulkan, and Metal's [[position]] is (x, y, z, 1/w));
     * the glslang paths define RSX_FRAGCOORD_W_IS_RCP. Emitted only where the
     * body uses it, so every other program stays byte-identical. */
    if (strstr(o.p, "_rsx_inv_w("))
        out_puts(&p,
            "#ifdef RSX_FRAGCOORD_W_IS_RCP\n"
            "#define _rsx_inv_w(p) ((p).w)\n"
            "#else\n"
            "#define _rsx_inv_w(p) (1.0 / (p).w)\n"
            "#endif\n");
    /* Texture bank. With no cube units (the default) emit the exact legacy
     * array declaration so 2D-only programs are byte-identical. When any unit
     * is a cubemap, declare each unit individually at its t-register so the
     * cube units can be TextureCube while the rest stay Texture2D. */
    if (tex_sep_mask == 0) {
        out_puts(&p, "Texture2D    rsx_tex[16] : register(t0);\n");
    } else {
        char decl[64];
        for (u32 u = 0; u < 16; u++) {
            snprintf(decl, sizeof(decl), "%s rsx_tex%u : register(t%u);\n",
                     ((tex_cube_mask >> u) & 1u) ? "TextureCube" :
                     ((tex_vol_mask >> u) & 1u)  ? "Texture3D  " : "Texture2D  ", u, u);
            out_puts(&p, decl);
        }
    }
    out_puts(&p,
        "SamplerState rsx_samp[16] : register(s0);\n"
    );
    if (tex_shadow_mask)
        out_puts(&p,
            "SamplerComparisonState rsx_shadow_samp[16] : register(s16);\n"
        );
    if (fp_helper_mask & 1u) {
        /* RPCS3 behavior reference (GPL-2.0): linear/sRGB piecewise transfer
         * thresholds and UNORM byte order from FragmentProgramDecompiler.cpp
         * and RSXFragmentPrologue.glsl. These HLSL helpers are independently
         * expressed for ps3recomp. */
        out_puts(&p,
            "float4 _rsx_linear_to_srgb(float4 c) {\n"
            "    float4 lo = c * 12.92;\n"
            "    float4 hi = 1.055 * pow(max(c, (float4)0.0), 1.0 / 2.4) - 0.055;\n"
            "    return saturate(float4(c.x < 0.0031308 ? lo.x : hi.x, c.y < 0.0031308 ? lo.y : hi.y,\n"
            "                           c.z < 0.0031308 ? lo.z : hi.z, c.w < 0.0031308 ? lo.w : hi.w));\n"
            "}\n"
            "float4 _rsx_srgb_to_linear(float4 c) {\n"
            "    float4 lo = c / 12.92;\n"
            "    float4 hi = pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);\n"
            "    return float4(c.x > 0.04045 ? hi.x : lo.x, c.y > 0.04045 ? hi.y : lo.y,\n"
            "                  c.z > 0.04045 ? hi.z : lo.z, c.w > 0.04045 ? hi.w : lo.w);\n"
            "}\n"
            "uint _rsx_pack_unorm4x8(float4 c) {\n"
            "    uint4 q = (uint4)round(saturate(c) * 255.0);\n"
            "    return (q.x & 255u) | ((q.y & 255u) << 8) | ((q.z & 255u) << 16) | ((q.w & 255u) << 24);\n"
            "}\n"
            "float4 _rsx_unpack_unorm4x8(float c) {\n"
            "    uint q = asuint(c);\n"
            "    return float4(q & 255u, (q >> 8) & 255u, (q >> 16) & 255u, (q >> 24) & 255u) / 255.0;\n"
            "}\n"
        );
    }
    if (buffered) {
        char constants_decl[192];
        snprintf(
            constants_decl, sizeof(constants_decl),
            "cbuffer PSConstants : register(b1) {\n"
            "    float4 fp_constants[%u];\n"
            "    float4 fp_alpha;\n"
            "};\n",
            buffered_constant_count ? buffered_constant_count : 1u);
        out_puts(&p, constants_decl);
    }
    if (shadow) for (u32 u = 0; u < 16; u++)
        if ((sampled_units & (1u << u)) && shadow[u].enabled)
            fp_shadow_helper(&p, u, tex_sep_mask, &shadow[u]);
    if (gamma_units) fp_gamma_helper(&p);
    if (expand_units || bx2_units) fp_expand_helper(&p);
    /* NV40 pack/unpack. A packed word travels on in a float's bits, so the
     * packs bitcast and the unpacks bitcast back; the sRGB forms follow
     * RPCS3's _builtin_pkg/_builtin_upg (linear_to_srgb, srgb_to_linear).
     * These were the opcodes inFAMOUS 2's character materials used and the
     * decompiler skipped, leaving the destination with whatever it held.
     * Only for a program that uses one, so every other program's text is
     * unchanged. */
    if (uses_pack) out_puts(&p,
        "uint   _rsx_pk4ub(float4 v) { uint4 b = (uint4)round(saturate(v) * 255.0); return b.x | (b.y << 8) | (b.z << 16) | (b.w << 24); }\n"
        "float4 _rsx_up4ub(float v) { uint u = asuint(v); return float4(u & 255u, (u >> 8) & 255u, (u >> 16) & 255u, (u >> 24) & 255u) / 255.0; }\n"
        "uint   _rsx_pk4b(float4 v) { uint4 b = (uint4)((int4)round(clamp(v, -1.0, 1.0) * 127.0)) & 255u; return b.x | (b.y << 8) | (b.z << 16) | (b.w << 24); }\n"
        "float4 _rsx_up4b(float v) { uint u = asuint(v); int4 b = int4(u & 255u, (u >> 8) & 255u, (u >> 16) & 255u, (u >> 24) & 255u); b = (b << 24) >> 24; return clamp((float4)b / 127.0, -1.0, 1.0); }\n"
        "uint   _rsx_pk2us(float4 v) { uint2 b = (uint2)round(saturate(v.xy) * 65535.0); return b.x | (b.y << 16); }\n"
        "float4 _rsx_up2us(float v) { uint u = asuint(v); return float4(u & 65535u, u >> 16, u & 65535u, u >> 16) / 65535.0; }\n"
        "uint   _rsx_pk2h(float4 v) { return f32tof16(v.x) | (f32tof16(v.y) << 16); }\n"
        "float4 _rsx_up2h(float v) { uint u = asuint(v); return float4(f16tof32(u & 65535u), f16tof32(u >> 16), f16tof32(u & 65535u), f16tof32(u >> 16)); }\n"
        "float4 _rsx_lin2srgb(float4 cl) { cl = saturate(cl); float4 low = cl * 12.92; float4 high = 1.055 * pow(cl, 1.0 / 2.4) - 0.055; return saturate((cl < 0.0031308) ? low : high); }\n"
        "float4 _rsx_srgb2lin(float4 cs) { float4 a = cs / 12.92; float4 b = pow(max(cs + 0.055, 0.0) / 1.055, 2.4); return (cs > 0.04045) ? b : a; }\n");
    if (targets == 1 && !depth_export) {
        out_puts(&p, "float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_TARGET {\n");
    } else {
        out_puts(&p, "struct PSOutput {\n");
        for (u32 t = 0; t < targets; t++) {
            char member[64];
            snprintf(member, sizeof(member),
                     "    float4 t%u : SV_TARGET%u;\n", t, t);
            out_puts(&p, member);
        }
        if (depth_export)
            out_puts(&p, "    float depth : SV_Depth;\n");
        out_puts(&p, "};\n"
                     "PSOutput main(PSInput input) {\n");
    }
    if (!o.ok || !p.ok) return -1;
    if (o.len + p.len + 1 > out_size) return -1;
    memmove(out + p.len, out, o.len + 1);
    memcpy(out, preamble, p.len);
    return count;
}

int rsx_fp_decompile_ex(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl,
                        u32 tex_cube_mask, char* out, u32 out_size)
{
    return rsx_fp_decompile_internal(ucode, max_bytes, ctrl, tex_cube_mask,
        0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, out, out_size, NULL);
}

        0, tex_shadow_mask, tex_shadow_compare_key, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL,
        out, out_size, NULL);
}

static float fp_half_to_float(u16 h)
{
    const u32 sign = (u32)(h & 0x8000u) << 16;
    u32 exponent = (h >> 10) & 0x1Fu;
    u32 mantissa = h & 0x03FFu;
    u32 bits;
    if (exponent == 0) {
        if (mantissa == 0) {
            bits = sign;
        } else {
            exponent = 127u - 15u + 1u;
            while ((mantissa & 0x0400u) == 0) {
                mantissa <<= 1;
                exponent--;
            }
            mantissa &= 0x03FFu;
            bits = sign | (exponent << 23) | (mantissa << 13);
        }
    } else if (exponent == 0x1Fu) {
        bits = sign | 0x7F800000u | (mantissa << 13);
    } else {
        bits = sign | ((exponent + (127u - 15u)) << 23) | (mantissa << 13);
    }
    float value;
    memcpy(&value, &bits, sizeof(value));
    return value;
}

float rsx_fp_alpha_ref(u32 raw, u32 surface_color_format)
{
    /* NV4097 SET_SURFACE_FORMAT color type values: 0x0B=F_W16Z16Y16X16,
     * 0x0C=F_W32Z32Y32X32, 0x0D=F_X32. */
    if (surface_color_format == 0x0Bu)
        return fp_half_to_float((u16)(raw & 0xFFFFu));
    if (surface_color_format == 0x0Cu || surface_color_format == 0x0Du) {
        float value;
        memcpy(&value, &raw, sizeof(value));
        return value;
    }
    return (float)(raw & 0xFFu) / 255.0f;
}

/* The comparison the alpha test has to pass. The alpha it tests is colour
 * target 0's, which for a single-target program is the returned value itself
 * and for an MRT one is the returned struct's first member -- the NV40 alpha
 * test has one input however many targets the program feeds. `cmp` is the
 * CELL_GCM function minus 0x200, with NEVER (0) spelled out and ALWAYS (7)
 * already handled by the caller. */
static void fp_alpha_pass_expr(u32 cmp, const char* alpha, char* out, u32 out_size)
{
    static const char* op[8] = { NULL, "<", "==", "<=", ">", "!=", ">=", NULL };
    if (cmp == 0 || cmp >= 7 || !op[cmp])
        snprintf(out, out_size, "false");
    else
        snprintf(out, out_size, "%s.a %s _rsx_alpha_ref", alpha, op[cmp]);
}

/* Where that alpha lives, and what type the value being returned has. */
/* RPCS3 behavior reference (GPL-2.0): FragmentProgramDecompiler.cpp TEX0..9
 * override and rsx_decode.h AA fields. Independently written HLSL adaptation;
 * no RPCS3 source copied. SV_POSITION.w is reciprocal clip W in D3D. */
int rsx_fp_apply_raster_controls(char* hlsl, u32 out_size,
                                u32 texcoord_mask, u32 aa_control)
{
    if (!hlsl || !out_size) return -1;
    char prefix[1600];
    size_t prefix_len = 0;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        if (!(texcoord_mask & (1u << i))) continue;
        int n = snprintf(prefix + prefix_len, sizeof(prefix) - prefix_len,
            "\n    input.tc%u.z = 0.0; input.tc%u.w = rcp(input.position.w);\n", i, i);
        if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof(prefix) - prefix_len) return -1;
        prefix_len += (size_t)n;
    }
    if (prefix_len) {
        char* entry = strstr(hlsl, "main(PSInput input)");
        char* brace = entry ? strchr(entry, '{') : NULL;
        if (!brace || strlen(hlsl) + prefix_len + 1 > out_size) return -1;
        char* body = brace + 1;
        memmove(body + prefix_len, body, strlen(body) + 1);
        memcpy(body, prefix, prefix_len);
    }
    if (!(aa_control & 1u) || !(aa_control & 0x110u)) return (int)prefix_len;
    char* marker = NULL;
    for (char* p = strstr(hlsl, "    return "); p; p = strstr(p + 1, "    return "))
        marker = p;
    char* end = marker ? strstr(marker, ";\n}\n") : NULL;
    if (!end) return -1;
    char expr[128];
    size_t len = (size_t)(end - (marker + 11));
    if (len >= sizeof(expr)) return -1;
    memcpy(expr, marker + 11, len); expr[len] = 0;
    char suffix[1024];
    const int mrt = strstr(hlsl, "struct PSOutput") != NULL;
    int n = snprintf(suffix, sizeof(suffix), "    %s _rsx_aa_out = %s;\n",
                     mrt ? "PSOutput" : "float4", expr);
    if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof(suffix)) return -1;
    size_t used = (size_t)n;
    /* One-sample A2C fallback: stochastic coverage, as in RPCS3's
     * RSXFragmentPrologue.glsl. Independently chosen integer pixel hash;
     * evaluate original alpha before alpha-to-one modifies the output. */
    if (aa_control & 0x10u) {
        n = snprintf(suffix + used, sizeof(suffix) - used,
            "    uint _rsx_cov = (uint)input.position.x * 1664525u + (uint)input.position.y * 1013904223u;\n"
            "    _rsx_cov ^= _rsx_cov >> 16; _rsx_cov *= 2246822519u; _rsx_cov ^= _rsx_cov >> 13;\n"
            "    if (!(%s.a > (float)(_rsx_cov & 65535u) / 65536.0)) discard;\n",
            mrt ? "_rsx_aa_out.t0" : "_rsx_aa_out");
        if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof(suffix) - used) return -1;
        used += (size_t)n;
    }
    if (mrt && (aa_control & 0x100u)) {
        for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            char semantic[32]; snprintf(semantic, sizeof(semantic), "SV_TARGET%u", i);
            if (!strstr(hlsl, semantic)) continue;
            n = snprintf(suffix + used, sizeof(suffix) - used,
                         "    _rsx_aa_out.t%u.a = 1.0;\n", i);
            if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof(suffix) - used) return -1;
            used += (size_t)n;
        }
    } else if (aa_control & 0x100u) {
        n = snprintf(suffix + used, sizeof(suffix) - used, "    _rsx_aa_out.a = 1.0;\n");
        if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof(suffix) - used) return -1;
        used += (size_t)n;
    }
    n = snprintf(suffix + used, sizeof(suffix) - used, "    return _rsx_aa_out;\n}\n");
    if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof(suffix) - used) return -1;
    used += (size_t)n;
    if ((size_t)(marker - hlsl) + used + 1 > out_size) return -1;
    memcpy(marker, suffix, used + 1);
    return 1;
}

static int fp_returns_struct(const char* hlsl)
{
    return strstr(hlsl, "struct PSOutput") != NULL;
}

int rsx_fp_apply_alpha_test(char* hlsl, u32 out_size, u32 func, float ref)
{
    if (!hlsl || out_size == 0)
        return -1;

    const u32 cmp = func >= 0x0200u && func <= 0x0207u ? func - 0x0200u : 7u;
    if (cmp == 7u)
        return 0;

    char* marker = NULL;
    for (char* p = strstr(hlsl, "    return "); p;
         p = strstr(p + 1, "    return "))
        marker = p;
    if (!marker)
        return -1;
    char* expression = marker + strlen("    return ");
    char* terminator = strstr(expression, ";\n}\n");
    if (!terminator || terminator == expression ||
        (size_t)(terminator - expression) >= 96)
        return -1;
    char output[96];
    memcpy(output, expression, (size_t)(terminator - expression));
    output[terminator - expression] = '\0';

    const int mrt = fp_returns_struct(hlsl);
    char pass[96];
    fp_alpha_pass_expr(cmp, mrt ? "_rsx_out.t0" : "_rsx_out", pass, sizeof(pass));
    char suffix[512];
    const int n = snprintf(suffix, sizeof(suffix),
        "    %s _rsx_out = %s;\n"
        "    const float _rsx_alpha_ref = %.9g;\n"
        "    if (!(%s)) discard;\n"
        "    return _rsx_out;\n}\n",
        mrt ? "PSOutput" : "float4", output, (double)ref, pass);
    if (n < 0 || (u32)n >= sizeof(suffix))
        return -1;
    const size_t prefix = (size_t)(marker - hlsl);
    if (prefix + (size_t)n + 1 > out_size)
        return -1;
    memcpy(marker, suffix, (size_t)n + 1);
    return 1;
}

int rsx_fp_apply_alpha_test_buffered(
    char* hlsl, u32 out_size, u32 func)
{
    if (!hlsl || out_size == 0)
        return -1;

    const u32 cmp =
        func >= 0x0200u && func <= 0x0207u ? func - 0x0200u : 7u;
    if (cmp == 7u)
        return 0;

    char* marker = NULL;
    for (char* p = strstr(hlsl, "    return "); p;
         p = strstr(p + 1, "    return "))
        marker = p;
    if (!marker)
        return -1;
    char* expression = marker + strlen("    return ");
    char* terminator = strstr(expression, ";\n}\n");
    if (!terminator || terminator == expression ||
        (size_t)(terminator - expression) >= 96)
        return -1;
    char output[96];
    memcpy(output, expression, (size_t)(terminator - expression));
    output[terminator - expression] = '\0';

    const int mrt = fp_returns_struct(hlsl);
    char pass[96];
    fp_alpha_pass_expr(cmp, mrt ? "_rsx_out.t0" : "_rsx_out", pass, sizeof(pass));
    char suffix[512];
    const int n = snprintf(
        suffix, sizeof(suffix),
        "    %s _rsx_out = %s;\n"
        "    const float _rsx_alpha_ref = fp_alpha.x;\n"
        "    if (!(%s)) discard;\n"
        "    return _rsx_out;\n}\n",
        mrt ? "PSOutput" : "float4", output, pass);
    if (n < 0 || (u32)n >= sizeof(suffix))
        return -1;
    const size_t prefix = (size_t)(marker - hlsl);
    if (prefix + (size_t)n + 1 > out_size)
        return -1;
    memcpy(marker, suffix, (size_t)n + 1);
    return 1;
}

/* --- kept from this tree when adopting the newer decompiler ---------------
 * rsx_d3d12_backend.c calls both of these: extract_consts feeds the per-draw
 * fp_k[] slots, code_hash keys the PSO cache on the ucode rather than the
 * constants. The live-draw engine does not need them, so they are absent
 * upstream in caner's fork. */

/* Walk a program the same way the decompiler does and copy out its inline
 * constants in the SAME order the decompiler assigns fp_k[] indices. The backend
 * calls this per draw, so re-patched constants take effect without recompiling. */
int rsx_fp_extract_consts(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, float* out, int max_out)
{
    if (!ucode || !out) return 0;
    u32 off = 0; int n = 0;
    while (off + 16 <= max_bytes) {
        u32 w0 = rsx_fp_read_word(ucode + off + 0);
        u32 w1 = rsx_fp_read_word(ucode + off + 4);
        u32 w2 = rsx_fp_read_word(ucode + off + 8);
        u32 w3 = rsx_fp_read_word(ucode + off + 12);
        off += 16;
        int has_k = fp_instruction_has_constant(w1, w2, w3);
        if (has_k) {
            if (off + 16 > max_bytes) return -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                u32 cw = rsx_fp_sanitize_constant_word(
                    rsx_fp_read_word(ucode + off + i * 4));
                if (n < max_out) memcpy(&out[n * 4 + i], &cw, 4);
            }
            off += 16;
            if (n < max_out) n++;
        }
        if (w0 & FP_END) break;
    }
    { static int dbg = -1;
      if (dbg < 0) { const char* e = getenv("FP_KDBG"); dbg = e ? atoi(e) : 0; }
      if (dbg) { static int m = 0; if (PS3_LOG_FIRST(m, 3)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[FPK] %d consts%c", n, 10);
        for (int _q = 0; _q < n; _q++)
            fprintf(stderr, "   k[%2d] = (%g %g %g %g)%c", _q, out[_q*4+0],
                    out[_q*4+1], out[_q*4+2], out[_q*4+3], 10); } }
    }
    return n;
}

/* FNV-1a over a program's INSTRUCTION words only, skipping the inline constant
 * slots. With constants hoisted into fp_k[] the compiled shader does not depend
 * on their values, so including them in the pipeline key made it change every
 * time the title re-patched a constant -- which is exactly what thrashed the
 * cache. */
u32 rsx_fp_code_hash(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes)
{
    u32 h = 2166136261u;
    if (!ucode) return h;
    u32 off = 0;
    while (off + 16 <= max_bytes) {
        u32 w0 = rsx_fp_read_word(ucode + off + 0);
        u32 w1 = rsx_fp_read_word(ucode + off + 4);
        u32 w2 = rsx_fp_read_word(ucode + off + 8);
        u32 w3 = rsx_fp_read_word(ucode + off + 12);
        for (u32 i = 0; i < 16; i++) { h ^= ucode[off + i]; h *= 16777619u; }
        off += 16;
        int has_k = fp_instruction_has_constant(w1, w2, w3);
        if (has_k) {
            if (off + 16 > max_bytes) return 0;
            off += 16;                    /* skip the constant, do not hash it */
        }
        if (w0 & FP_END) break;
    }
    return h;
}

/* Scale texel-space coordinates to the 0..1 range HLSL sampling expects.
 *
 * An RSX texture whose format carries RSX_TEX_FMT_UNNORM (0x40) is addressed in
 * TEXELS, not normalised units. ps1_netemu composites the PS1 framebuffer with
 * exactly that: format 0xE2 (A1R5G5B5 | UNNORM | LINEAR) over a 1024x512
 * texture, and a quad whose texture coordinates run 1..638 by 2..474 --
 *
 *     [uvdbg] unit=0 ps1fb 1024x512 pitch=2048 fmt=0xE2
 *     [uvdbg]   v0 pos(-1.0 -1.0) tc(1.0000 2.0000)
 *     [uvdbg]   v2 pos(0.8 0.8)   tc(638.0000 474.0000)
 *
 * The bit was only ever masked OUT of the base format so the decoder could
 * recognise A1R5G5B5, and never honoured for addressing. So the sampler was
 * handed coordinates hundreds of times out of range, which under clamp lands on
 * one edge texel for the whole quad -- a flat, uniform result. That is the
 * black screen: the PS1 renders, the composite pass runs, and it samples one
 * corner texel.
 *
 * D3D12 has no unnormalised addressing mode, so the division has to happen in
 * the shader. Doing it as a post-pass over the generated HLSL rather than
 * inside the emitter keeps it beside rsx_fp_apply_alpha_test, which already
 * works this way, and leaves every non-UNNORM program byte-identical.
 *
 * Cube units are skipped: their coordinate is a float3 direction, and
 * RSX_TEX_FMT_UNNORM has no meaning for one.
 */
int rsx_fp_apply_unnorm_scale(char* hlsl, u32 hlsl_size, u32 unnorm_mask,
                              const u32 dim[][2], u32 cube_mask)
{
    if (!hlsl || !dim) return -1;
    if (!unnorm_mask) return 0;
    int patched = 0;
    static const char* methods[] = {
        "SampleGrad(", "SampleCmp(", "SampleCmpLevelZero(",
        "SampleLevel(", "SampleBias(", "Sample("
    };

    for (u32 u = 0; u < 16; u++) {
        if (!((unnorm_mask >> u) & 1u) || ((cube_mask >> u) & 1u)) continue;
        const u32 w = dim[u][0], h = dim[u][1];
        if (!w || !h) return -1;
        char resource[32];
        snprintf(resource, sizeof resource, "rsx_tex[%u]", u);
        char scale[80];
        snprintf(scale, sizeof scale, " * float2(%.9g, %.9g)",
                 1.0 / (double)w, 1.0 / (double)h);
        const size_t scale_len = strlen(scale);
        char* search = hlsl;
        int unit_patched = 0;

        for (;;) {
            char* tex = strstr(search, resource);
            if (!tex) break;
            char* dot = tex + strlen(resource);
            if (*dot != '.') { search = dot; continue; }
            const char* method = NULL;
            int method_index = -1;
            for (int m = 0; m < (int)(sizeof methods / sizeof methods[0]); m++) {
                const size_t ml = strlen(methods[m]);
                if (strncmp(dot + 1, methods[m], ml) == 0) {
                    method = methods[m]; method_index = m; break;
                }
            }
            if (!method) { search = dot + 1; continue; }

            char* open = dot + 1 + strlen(method) - 1;
            char* starts[5] = {0};
            char* ends[5] = {0};
            int argc = 0, depth = 0;
            char* close = NULL;
            starts[0] = open + 1;
            for (char* p = open + 1; *p; p++) {
                if (*p == '(') depth++;
                else if (*p == ')') {
                    if (depth == 0) {
                        if (argc < 5) ends[argc] = p;
                        argc++;
                        close = p;
                        break;
                    }
                    depth--;
                } else if (*p == ',' && depth == 0) {
                    if (argc >= 4) return -1;
                    ends[argc] = p;
                    argc++;
                    starts[argc] = p + 1;
                }
            }
            if (!close || argc < 2 || argc > 5) return -1;

            /* Coordinates are argument 1. SampleGrad derivatives are in texel
             * units too, so scale arguments 2 and 3 along with the coordinate. */
            const int last_to_scale = method_index == 0 ? 3 : 1;
            for (int a = last_to_scale; a >= 1; a--) {
                if (a >= argc) {
                    if (method_index == 0) return -1;
                    continue;
                }
                char* begin = starts[a];
                char* end = ends[a];
                while (begin < end && (*begin == ' ' || *begin == '\t' || *begin == '\r' || *begin == '\n')) begin++;
                while (end > begin && (end[-1] == ' ' || end[-1] == '\t' || end[-1] == '\r' || end[-1] == '\n')) end--;
                const size_t used = strlen(hlsl);
                const size_t prefix_len = 1;
                const size_t insert_len = scale_len + prefix_len;
                if (used + insert_len + 1 > hlsl_size) return -1;
                memmove(end + scale_len, end, used - (size_t)(end - hlsl) + 1);
                memcpy(end, scale, scale_len);
                memmove(begin + 1, begin, used - (size_t)(begin - hlsl) + scale_len + 1);
                *begin = '(';
                close += insert_len;
                for (int j = a + 1; j < argc; j++) {
                    starts[j] += insert_len;
                    ends[j] += insert_len;
                }
                unit_patched++;
            }
            patched += unit_patched;
            search = close + 1;
        }
        if (!unit_patched) return -1;
    }
    return patched;
}

/* NV4097_SET_SHADER_PACKER accepts any nonzero value. Floating surfaces and
 * 32-bit exports bypass the integer framebuffer's RGB transfer function. */
int rsx_fp_srgb_output_enabled(u32 packer, u32 ctrl, u32 color_format)
{
    return packer != 0 && !(ctrl & FP_CTRL_32BIT_EXPORTS) &&
           color_format != 0x0Bu && color_format != 0x0Cu && color_format != 0x0Du;
}

int rsx_fp_apply_srgb_output(char* hlsl, u32 capacity)
{
    static const char helper[] =
        "float4 _rsx_srgb_output(float4 v) {\n"
        "    float3 lo = v.rgb * 12.92;\n"
        "    float3 hi = 1.055 * pow(max(v.rgb, (float3)0), (float3)(1.0 / 2.4)) - 0.055;\n"
        "    float3 rgb = float3(v.r < 0.0031308 ? lo.r : hi.r,\n"
        "                         v.g < 0.0031308 ? lo.g : hi.g,\n"
        "                         v.b < 0.0031308 ? lo.b : hi.b);\n"
        "    return float4(saturate(rgb), v.a);\n}\n";
    if (!hlsl || !capacity) return -1;
    size_t len = 0;
    while (len < capacity && hlsl[len]) ++len;
    if (len == capacity || strstr(hlsl, "_rsx_srgb_output")) return -1;
    char* marker = NULL;
    for (char* p = strstr(hlsl, "    return "); p;
         p = strstr(p + 1, "    return ")) marker = p;
    if (!marker) return -1;
    const char* expression = marker + strlen("    return ");
    const char* end = strstr(expression, ";\n}\n");
    if (!end || end == expression || (size_t)(end - expression) >= 96 || end[4])
        return -1;
    char output[96];
    memcpy(output, expression, (size_t)(end - expression));
    output[end - expression] = 0;
    const int mrt = strstr(hlsl, "struct PSOutput") != NULL;
    char suffix[1024];
    int n = snprintf(suffix, sizeof suffix, "    %s _rsx_color_out = %s;\n",
                     mrt ? "PSOutput" : "float4", output);
    if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof suffix) return -1;
    if (mrt) {
        unsigned targets = 0;
        for (unsigned t = 0; t < 4; ++t) {
            char field[64];
            snprintf(field, sizeof field, "    float4 t%u : SV_TARGET%u;", t, t);
            if (!strstr(hlsl, field)) continue;
            const int added = snprintf(suffix + n, sizeof suffix - (size_t)n,
                "    _rsx_color_out.t%u = _rsx_srgb_output(_rsx_color_out.t%u);\n", t, t);
            if (added < 0 || (size_t)added >= sizeof suffix - (size_t)n) return -1;
            n += added; ++targets;
        }
        if (!targets) return -1;
    } else {
        const int added = snprintf(suffix + n, sizeof suffix - (size_t)n,
            "    _rsx_color_out = _rsx_srgb_output(_rsx_color_out);\n");
        if (added < 0 || (size_t)added >= sizeof suffix - (size_t)n) return -1;
        n += added;
    }
    const int added = snprintf(suffix + n, sizeof suffix - (size_t)n,
                              "    return _rsx_color_out;\n}\n");
    if (added < 0 || (size_t)added >= sizeof suffix - (size_t)n) return -1;
    n += added;
    const size_t prefix = (size_t)(marker - hlsl);
    const size_t helper_len = sizeof helper - 1;
    if (helper_len + prefix + (size_t)n + 1 > capacity) return -1;
    /* All parsing/capacity checks precede the first mutation. */
    memcpy(marker, suffix, (size_t)n + 1);
    memmove(hlsl + helper_len, hlsl, prefix + (size_t)n + 1);
    memcpy(hlsl, helper, helper_len);
    return 1;
}

int rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_color_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask,
    const u8 gamma_masks[16], char* out, u32 out_size, u32* out_constant_count)
{
    return rsx_fp_decompile_internal(ucode, max_bytes, ctrl, tex_cube_mask,
        0, 0, 0, 1, NULL, gamma_masks, NULL,
        out, out_size, out_constant_count);
}


===== FILE: \libs\video\rsx_fp_decompiler.h =====
/*
 * ps3recomp - RSX Fragment Program (NV40 ISA) → HLSL decompiler
 *
 * Translates an RSX fragment shader (NVIDIA NV40 "nvfx" fragment program
 * encoding) into an HLSL pixel shader source string suitable for D3DCompile.
 *
 * See docs/RSX_FRAGMENT_PROGRAM.md for the instruction encoding reference
 * (sourced from Mesa/nouveau nvfx_shader.h). This module is self-contained:
 * it has no D3D12 dependency and can be built/tested standalone.
 */

#ifndef PS3RECOMP_RSX_FP_DECOMPILER_H
#define PS3RECOMP_RSX_FP_DECOMPILER_H

#include "ps3emu/ps3types.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define RSX_FP_BUFFERED_CONSTANTS_API 1
#define RSX_FP_MAX_INLINE_CONSTANTS 2048u

/* Source capacity for native backends decoding up to 4096 bytecode bytes.
 * Predicated instructions can expand beyond 32 KiB of HLSL. This is a caller
 * allocation size, not a limit imposed by the decompiler API. */
#define RSX_FP_HLSL_BUFFER_SIZE (256u * 1024u)

/* Runtime payload for a structurally decompiled fragment program. Values are
 * retained as host-order IEEE-754 bit patterns so signed zero, infinities,
 * NaNs, and NaN payloads survive the guest-word conversion exactly. One slot
 * is consumed per instruction that references CONST; multiple CONST operands
 * in that instruction share the slot, matching the RSX encoding. */
typedef struct rsx_fp_constant_block {
    u32 count;
    u32 values[RSX_FP_MAX_INLINE_CONSTANTS][4];
} rsx_fp_constant_block;

/* Read one fragment-program word from guest (PS3) memory: big-endian load
 * followed by a 16-bit half-word swap, yielding a host-order instruction
 * word. The decoder operates on host-order words. */
u32 rsx_fp_read_word(const u8* p);
u32 rsx_fp_sanitize_constant_word(u32 w);
/* Return a bit mask of texture units referenced by supported fetch opcodes;
 * returns ~0u for a malformed/truncated program or missing END instruction. */
u32 rsx_fp_texture_units(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes);
extern unsigned long long g_rsx_fp_nonfinite_constants;

/* Decompile an NV40 fragment program into an HLSL pixel shader.
 *
 *   ucode     : pointer to the fragment-program bytecode in guest memory
 *               (big-endian, half-word-swapped — i.e. exactly as the RSX
 *               reads it; this function applies rsx_fp_read_word internally).
 *   max_bytes : safety bound on how far to read (program stops at PROGRAM_END
 *               or when this many bytes are consumed).
 *   out       : caller buffer for the generated HLSL (NUL-terminated).
 *   out_size  : size of `out` in bytes.
 *
 * Returns the number of instructions decoded (>=0) on success, or -1 on
 * error (null args, output overflow). The emitted entry point is
 * `float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_TARGET`, matching the backend's
 * placeholder PSInput { float4 position : SV_POSITION; float4 col : COLOR; }.
 *
 * Texture sampling and full input plumbing are partial — see the doc's
 * "Integration TODO". Unhandled opcodes emit a comment and a safe default so
 * the shader still compiles.
 *
 *   ctrl : the NV4097_SET_SHADER_CONTROL word (reg 0x1D60) for this program.
 *          Bit 0x40 (CELL_GCM_SHADER_CONTROL_32_BITS_EXPORTS) selects the
 *          fragment-output register set: clear => fp16 output (color = h0),
 *          set => fp32 output (color = r0). Pass RSX_FP_CTRL_AUTO when no
 *          control word is available (standalone tests) to fall back to the
 *          legacy "whichever of r0/h0 was written" heuristic. */
#define RSX_FP_CTRL_AUTO 0xFFFFFFFFu
int rsx_fp_decompile(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, char* out, u32 out_size);

/* Apply the NV4097 fixed-function alpha test to an already-decompiled pixel
 * shader. D3D12 has no fixed-function alpha test, so the comparison is
 * emitted immediately before the shader's final color return. `func` uses
 * the CELL_GCM comparison values 0x200..0x207 and `ref` is normalized to the
 * render target's component representation. Returns 1 when a test was
 * inserted, 0 for ALWAYS, and -1 if the generated shader could not be
 * patched safely. */
int rsx_fp_apply_alpha_test(char* hlsl, u32 out_size, u32 func, float ref);

/* Apply texture-coordinate 2D overrides, one-sample stochastic alpha coverage,
 * and alpha-to-one after alpha test. Sample masking is host PSO state. */
int rsx_fp_apply_raster_controls(char* hlsl, u32 out_size,
                                 u32 texcoord_mask, u32 aa_control);

/* Decode NV4097_SET_ALPHA_REF for the active surface color format. Ordinary
 * integer render targets use the low 8 bits as UNORM8; W16Z16Y16X16 uses a
 * half float and X32/W32Z32Y32X32 use a 32-bit float. */
float rsx_fp_alpha_ref(u32 raw, u32 surface_color_format);

/* Scale texel-space (RSX_TEX_FMT_UNNORM) coordinates into HLSL's 0..1 range.
 * unnorm_mask selects the units; dim[u] gives that unit's {width, height};
 * cube units are skipped. Returns the number of Sample sites patched, or -1 if
 * the buffer would overflow. A no-op when unnorm_mask is 0. */
int rsx_fp_apply_unnorm_scale(char* hlsl, u32 hlsl_size, u32 unnorm_mask,
                              const u32 dim[][2], u32 cube_mask);

/* Decode NV4097_SET_ALPHA_REF for the active surface color format. Ordinary
 * integer render targets use the low 8 bits as UNORM8; W16Z16Y16X16 uses a
 * half float and X32/W32Z32Y32X32 use a 32-bit float. */
float rsx_fp_alpha_ref(u32 raw, u32 surface_color_format);

/* Same as rsx_fp_decompile, plus per-texture-unit dimensionality.
 *
 *   tex_cube_mask : bit N set => texture unit N is a CUBEMAP. Cube units are
 *                   declared `TextureCube` and sampled with the full
 *                   3-component direction (a.xyz); 2D units keep `Texture2D`
 *                   and a.xy sampling. Pass 0 for the legacy all-2D behavior
 *                   (rsx_fp_decompile forwards 0, so its output is unchanged
 *                   byte-for-byte).
 *
 * The mask must match what the backend actually binds: a cube unit needs a
 * TextureCube SRV at register tN, and a 2D unit a Texture2D SRV. See the
 * fragment lane report (scratch/a010_reports/fragment.md) for replay_main.c
 * call-site guidance. */
int rsx_fp_decompile_ex(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl,
                        u32 tex_cube_mask, char* out, u32 out_size);

/* Shadow-texture variant. `tex_shadow_mask` selects depth-comparison units;
 * the 4-bit compare function for unit N is stored in bits [4*N, 4*N+3] of
 * `tex_shadow_compare_key` (raw SET_TEXTURE_ADDRESS ZFUNC nibble). */
int rsx_fp_decompile_shadow_ex(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl,
                               u32 tex_cube_mask, u32 tex_shadow_mask,
                               u64 tex_shadow_compare_key,
                               char* out, u32 out_size);

/* Buffered-constant variant of rsx_fp_decompile_ex. Inline CONST payloads are
 * represented as fp_constants[N] in a b1 PSConstants cbuffer rather than
 * printed as HLSL literals. `out_constant_count` receives the exact slot
 * count and may be NULL. */
int rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask,
    char* out, u32 out_size, u32* out_constant_count);

/* Metadata-driven depth comparison. This path samples the depth plane with
 * the regular texture sampler and compares in shader code, so it does not
 * consume D3D12's comparison-sampler slots. */
typedef struct rsx_fp_shadow_desc {
    u8 enabled, func, linear, unnormalized;
} rsx_fp_shadow_desc;
void rsx_fp_shadow_desc_from_texture(rsx_fp_shadow_desc* out, u32 format,
    u32 dimension, u32 cube, u32 mips, u32 filter, u32 address, u32 control0);
int rsx_fp_decompile_shadow_desc_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask,
    const rsx_fp_shadow_desc shadow[16],
    char* out, u32 out_size);
int rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_shadow_desc_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask,
    const rsx_fp_shadow_desc shadow[16],
    char* out, u32 out_size, u32* out_constant_count);
int rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_shadow_color_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask,
    const rsx_fp_shadow_desc shadow[16], const u8 gamma_masks[16],
    char* out, u32 out_size, u32* out_constant_count);
int rsx_fp_decompile_shadow_desc_color_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask,
    const rsx_fp_shadow_desc shadow[16], const u8 gamma_masks[16],
    char* out, u32 out_size);
int rsx_fp_decompile_shadow_gamma_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask,
    u32 tex_shadow_mask, u64 tex_shadow_compare_key,
    const u8 gamma_masks[16], char* out, u32 out_size);
int rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_shadow_gamma_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask,
    u32 tex_shadow_mask, u64 tex_shadow_compare_key,
    const u8 gamma_masks[16], char* out, u32 out_size,
    u32* out_constant_count);

/* Buffered-constant shadow-texture variant; see rsx_fp_decompile_shadow_ex. */
int rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_shadow_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask,
    u32 tex_shadow_mask, u64 tex_shadow_compare_key,
    char* out, u32 out_size, u32* out_constant_count);

/* Extract the exact runtime inline-CONST payload. Returns the slot count on
 * success or -1 for an unterminated/truncated/oversized program. */
int rsx_fp_collect_constants(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, rsx_fp_constant_block* out);

/* Canonical structural fragment-program hash. Instruction bytes and their
 * order are hashed; inline CONST payload bytes are skipped. Returns zero for
 * malformed input. */
u64 rsx_fp_structural_hash(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u64 seed);

/* Hash the exact legacy HLSL literal spellings (%g) for a program while also
 * retaining structural identity. This is intended for aggregate diagnostics;
 * PSO identity should use rsx_fp_structural_hash in buffered mode. */
u64 rsx_fp_literal_source_hash(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u64 seed);

/* Buffered-alpha counterpart to rsx_fp_apply_alpha_test. It emits the compare
 * against fp_alpha.x from PSConstants instead of embedding a numeric value. */
int rsx_fp_apply_alpha_test_buffered(
    char* hlsl, u32 out_size, u32 func);

/* Plan one 256-byte-aligned allocation in a fence-retired PS constant ring.
 * Returns 1 when it fits, 0 when the caller must submit/wait/reset first, and
 * -1 when one allocation can never fit. */
int rsx_fp_constant_ring_plan(
    u32 used, u32 capacity, u32 data_bytes,
    u32* out_offset, u32* out_allocation_bytes);

/* Plan one already-aligned fixed-size vertex-constant block.  The caller must
 * fence and retry from offset zero when this returns 0; silently dropping the
 * draw would leave a multi-buffered display surface on an older generation. */
int rsx_vertex_constant_ring_plan(
    u32 used, u32 capacity, u32 block_bytes, u32* out_offset);

/* Integer framebuffer sRGB conversion (NV4097_SET_SHADER_PACKER / 0x1FEC).
 * Pass the decoded surface color format. Any nonzero packer enables it for
 * half exports; floating surfaces and 32-bit exports bypass conversion. */
int rsx_fp_srgb_output_enabled(u32 packer, u32 ctrl, u32 color_format);

/* Apply RGB-only linear-to-sRGB conversion to all emitted color targets,
 * before output quantization. Alpha and optional depth exports are preserved.
 * Returns 1, or -1 without mutation for malformed source/insufficient space.
 * Apply before alpha-test wrapping; disabled draws should skip this helper. */
int rsx_fp_apply_srgb_output(char* hlsl, u32 capacity);

/* Gamma metadata is a post-filter/post-remap RGBA lane mask, with formats
 * validated by rsx_texture_gamma_mask. EXP_TEX overrides gamma per fetch.
 * Old entry points pass NULL and preserve their source byte for byte. Returns
 * ~0u for a malformed/truncated program or missing END instruction. */
u32 rsx_fp_texture_gamma_units(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes,
                                const u8 gamma_masks[16]);
int rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_color_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask,
    const u8 gamma_masks[16], char* out, u32 out_size, u32* out_constant_count);
/* Both: depth comparison per unit and post-filter gamma per unit. */
/* Texture sign expansion (SET_TEXTURE_ADDRESS UNSIGNED_REMAP_BIASED):
 * expand_masks[u] is a post-remap RGBA lane mask of the lanes unit u
 * re-centres, plus bit 4 for 16-bit channels (rsx_texture_expand_mask).
 * Every TEX/TXP/TXB/TXL from such a unit returns (round(x*255)-128)/127 on
 * those lanes, less gamma lanes. A fetch carrying EXP_TEX (OPDEST bit 21,
 * the _bx2 modifier) returns x*2-1 on every lane on any unit and skips gamma
 * (RPCS3 _process_texel), from every entry point. The units whose fetches
 * expand are part of the pipeline's identity. */
u32 rsx_fp_texture_expand_units(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes,
                                 const u8 expand_masks[16]);
u32 rsx_fp_texture_bx2_units(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes);
int rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_shadow_color_expand_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask,
    const rsx_fp_shadow_desc shadow[16], const u8 gamma_masks[16],
    const u8 expand_masks[16],
    char* out, u32 out_size, u32* out_constant_count);
/* As above, with tex_vol_mask naming the units bound to a 3D texture: they
 * are declared Texture3D and sampled with three coordinates (TXP divides
 * all three by w), like cube units on their own t-register. */
int rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_shadow_color_expand_vol_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask, u32 tex_vol_mask,
    const rsx_fp_shadow_desc shadow[16], const u8 gamma_masks[16],
    const u8 expand_masks[16],
    char* out, u32 out_size, u32* out_constant_count);
int rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_shadow_color_ex(
    const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, u32 ctrl, u32 tex_cube_mask,
    const rsx_fp_shadow_desc shadow[16], const u8 gamma_masks[16],
    char* out, u32 out_size, u32* out_constant_count);

/* Return the mnemonic for an NV40 fragment opcode (or "?" if unknown).
 * Useful for disassembly/logging. */
const char* rsx_fp_opcode_name(u32 opcode);

/* Total byte length of the fragment program at `ucode` (including inline
 * CONST slots), up to and including the PROGRAM_END instruction, bounded by
 * `max_bytes`. Returns 0 if no terminator is found within the bound. Shared
 * walk logic so callers (e.g. a shader cache hashing the bytecode) agree with
 * the decompiler on where a program ends. */
u32 rsx_fp_program_size(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

/* Kept from this tree (see the .c) -- used by rsx_d3d12_backend.c. */
int rsx_fp_extract_consts(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes, float* out, int max_out);
u32 rsx_fp_code_hash(const u8* ucode, u32 max_bytes);
#endif /* PS3RECOMP_RSX_FP_DECOMPILER_H */


===== FILE: \libs\video\rsx_live_draw_config.c =====
/*
 * Neutral definitions for the state the live draw engine reads from its host
 * title.
 *
 * rsx_live_draw.c comes from caner's (canersaka) Yakuza: Dead Souls port, where
 * these are owned by the Yakuza runner: a config snapshot built from the
 * environment before main(), plus a few flags its A010 scene-debugging work
 * toggles at run time. The engine only ever reads them, and every path they
 * gate is Yakuza-specific, so a title that does not have them wants them all
 * off rather than absent.
 *
 * Defining them here keeps the engine buildable for any title without editing
 * it. A port that genuinely wants these behaviours should define them itself
 * and drop this file from its build rather than assign to them, since the
 * config object is const by design (read once, never mutated on a hot path).
 */

#include "ps3emu/yz_runtime_config.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#endif

/* All-zero: every optional behaviour and repair disabled. */
const yz_runtime_config g_yz_runtime_config;

#ifdef _WIN32
volatile LONG               g_yz_a010_reference_camera_active = 0;
volatile LONG               g_yz_a010_root_active             = 0;
volatile LONG               g_yz_movement_proof_phase         = 0;
volatile unsigned long long g_yz_auto_start_tick              = 0;
#endif

/*
 * ps3recomp - Track B live NV4097 draw path (implementation)
 *
 * See rsx_live_draw.h. This is the validated capture-replay D3D12 engine
 * (libs/video/tests/replay_main.c) lifted into a runtime module and driven by
 * the live FIFO consumer instead of an .rxs file:
 *   - rsx_dispatch register-file model (shared, unchanged)
 *   - NV40 VP/FP -> HLSL decompilers (shared, unchanged)
 *   - B1 render/sampler state -> D3D12 PSO + dynamic samplers + mip chains
 *
 * Differences from the harness:
 *   - guest memory comes from an injected resolver (the runtime's vm_base map),
 *     not a private arena;
 *   - present goes to a swap chain bound to the runtime's window, not a PPM
 *     readback;
 *   - the whole engine is gated behind RSX_DRAW (default ON; "0" = off).
 *

 * psdevwiki; RPCS3 as a read-only fact oracle only.
 */

/* Armed by the a010 AUTH repair only after its animation palette is resident. */
extern volatile LONG g_yz_a010_reference_camera_active;
/* Published when the Sunshine Orphanage AUTH root becomes live. */

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Engine state (module-static; single live RSX)
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------------*/

#define LD_SWAP_BUFFERS  2
#define MAX_SURFACES     64
#define MAX_TEXTURES     1024
#define MAX_RETIRED_TEXTURES 4096
#define MAX_VTEX         64
#define MAX_SAMPLERS     128
/*
 * A full live boot carries shader pairs from startup movies, menus, and AUTH
 * into the orphanage.  The old 256-entry cap was already exhausted there,
 * causing 155/328 sampled a010 groups to return NULL from get_pso().  The
 * one-frame reference alone uses 197 pairs.  A full visible boot through
 * orphanage and into Akiyama measured 2,296 distinct requested PSO keys before
 * the first presentation stall, so use the next power of two with headroom.
 */
#define MAX_PSOS         8192
#define FORMER_MAX_SHADER_BLOBS 2048
#define MAX_SHADER_BLOBS 8192
#define MAX_REJECTED_PSO_KEYS 8192
#define UPLOAD_SIZE      (64u * 1024 * 1024)
#define SHADER_DISK_CACHE_MAGIC   0x43535A59u /* "YZSC" */
/* v2: OP_KIL now emits discard (was a dropped TODO) — cached v1 pixel
 * shaders would silently keep the old no-discard codegen. */
#define SHADER_DISK_CACHE_VERSION 2u
#define SHADER_DISK_CACHE_MAX_BLOB (4u * 1024u * 1024u)

#define SRV_WHITE        0
#define SRV_SURFACE_BASE 1
#define SRV_ZDEPTH_BASE  (SRV_SURFACE_BASE + MAX_SURFACES)
#define SRV_TEXTURE_BASE (SRV_ZDEPTH_BASE + MAX_SURFACES)
#define SRV_VTEX_BASE    (SRV_TEXTURE_BASE + MAX_TEXTURES)
#define SRV_HEAP_SLOTS   (SRV_VTEX_BASE + MAX_VTEX)
#define SRV_DEPTH_SOURCE_BASE SRV_HEAP_SLOTS
#define UAV_ZDEPTH_BASE   (SRV_DEPTH_SOURCE_BASE + MAX_SURFACES)
/* Per-surface copy a draw samples when it reads its own render target. */
#define SRV_FEEDBACK_BASE (UAV_ZDEPTH_BASE + MAX_SURFACES)
/* Top-left windows of a surface for smaller textures that alias it (see surface_window). */
#define LD_SWIN_PER       2
#define SRV_SURF_WIN_BASE (SRV_FEEDBACK_BASE + MAX_SURFACES)
#define SRV_CPU_HEAP_SLOTS (SRV_SURF_WIN_BASE + MAX_SURFACES * LD_SWIN_PER)
#define SRV_TABLE_SIZE   16
#define SRV_RING_TABLES  4096

#define SMP_DEFAULT      0
#define SMP_CACHE_SLOTS  MAX_SAMPLERS
#define SMP_TABLE_SIZE   16
/* A shader-visible SAMPLER heap is hard-capped at 2048 descriptors by D3D12
 * (D3D12_MAX_SHADER_VISIBLE_SAMPLER_HEAP_SIZE). SMP_RING_TABLES*SMP_TABLE_SIZE
 * must stay <= 2048, else CreateDescriptorHeap fails. Identical sampler
 * tables share entries, so this is 128 unique tables between GPU flushes. */
#define SMP_RING_TABLES  128

#define CB_BLOCK_BYTES   ((512 + 2) * 16 + 16)
#define CB_BLOCK_ALIGNED ((CB_BLOCK_BYTES + 255) & ~255u)
#define CB_RING_BYTES    (CB_BLOCK_ALIGNED * SRV_RING_TABLES)
#define PS_CB_RING_BYTES CB_RING_BYTES
#define LD_VARIANT_SET_CAPACITY (MAX_SHADER_BLOBS * 2u)

#define VERT_STRIDE      (16 * 4 * 4)   /* 16 attrs * float4                  */
#define VERT_BUFFER_SIZE (256u * 1024u * 1024u)
#define INDEX_BUFFER_SIZE (64u * 1024u * 1024u)
#define LD_INVALID_SURFACE 0xFFFFFFFFu

/* gcm texture format bytes (mirror rsx_dispatch.h) */
#define TEX_FMT_B8         0x81
#define TEX_FMT_A1R5G5B5   0x82
#define TEX_FMT_A4R4G4B4   0x83
#define TEX_FMT_R5G6B5     0x84
#define TEX_FMT_A8R8G8B8   0x85
#define TEX_FMT_DXT1       0x86
#define TEX_FMT_DXT23      0x87
#define TEX_FMT_DXT45      0x88
#define TEX_FMT_G8B8       0x8B
#define TEX_FMT_DEPTH24_D8 0x90
#define TEX_FMT_LINEAR     0x20
#define TEX_FMT_UNNORM     0x40
#define TEX_FMT_BASE_MASK  0x9F

typedef struct {
    u32 location, offset;
    ID3D12Resource* tex;
    u32 w, h;
    DXGI_FORMAT fmt;
    ID3D12Resource* fb_tex;   /* feedback copy, see surface_feedback_srv */
    u32 pitch;                /* guest row pitch of colour target 0 (bytes), 0 = unknown */
    /* Top-left windows of the surface for smaller aliasing textures (see surface_window). */
    struct { ID3D12Resource* tex; ID3D12Resource* src; u32 w, h, wgen, used; } swin[LD_SWIN_PER];
    u32 swin_wgen;            /* bumped by every write into the surface; a window older than it is recopied */
#if !defined(YZ_PERF_CLEAN)
    u32 resource_serial;
    u32 last_write_generation;
    u32 last_write_kind;
    u32 last_create_generation;
    u32 last_draw_generation;
    u32 last_clear_generation;
    u32 last_copy_generation;
    u32 last_blit_generation;
    u32 last_resolve_generation;
    u32 last_other_generation;
    u32 last_guest_blit_generation;
    u32 last_present_copy_generation;
#endif
} surface_t;
typedef struct {
    u32 location, offset, pitch, width, height;
    int valid;
    int resolve_src;   /* surface slot + 1 a scaled blit resolves into this buffer; 0 = none */
} display_buffer_t;

    u32 location, offset;
    ID3D12Resource* tex;

    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES snapshot_state;

    int snapshot_valid;
    u64 draws;
    u64 depth_test_draws;
    u64 depth_write_draws;
    u64 depth_both_draws;
    int reject_logged;
} zdepth_t;
typedef struct {
    u32 location, offset, format, width, height, pitch, remap;
    u32 cubemap;
    ID3D12Resource* tex;
    u64 content_hash;

    u32 location, offset, format, width, height, pitch;

} vtexcache_t;
typedef struct { u64 key; ID3D12PipelineState* pso; } psocache_t;
typedef struct {
    u64 hash;

    char* source;
    ID3DBlob* blob;
} shader_blob_t;
typedef struct {
    shader_blob_t entries[MAX_SHADER_BLOBS];
    u32 count;
    u64 retained_source_bytes;
    u64 retained_blob_bytes;
} shader_blob_cache_t;
