    m(M_BEGIN_END, 0);
    CHECK(stub.n_draw == 0, "short inline stream mixed with immediate rejects group");
    m(M_VTXFMT, 0); /* no enabled inline attribute */
    m(M_BEGIN_END, RSX_PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES);
    m(M_INLINE_ARRAY, 0);
    immediate_vertex(0,0,0,0); immediate_vertex(1,0,0,0);
    immediate_vertex(0,1,0,0);
    m(M_BEGIN_END, 0);
    CHECK(stub.n_draw == 0, "undeclared inline stream mixed with immediate rejects group");
    m(M_BEGIN_END, RSX_PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES);
    immediate_vertex(0,0,0,0); immediate_vertex(1,0,0,0);
    immediate_vertex(0,1,0,0);
    m(M_BEGIN_END, 0);
    CHECK(stub.n_draw == 1, "BEGIN clears rejected inline source state");
    m(M_BEGIN_END, RSX_PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES);
    immediate_vertex(0,0,0,0); immediate_vertex(1,0,0,0);
    immediate_vertex(0,1,0,0);
    for (u32 i = 0; i <= RSX_DSP_INLINE_MAX_BYTES / 4u; i++)
        m(M_INLINE_ARRAY, 0);
    m(M_BEGIN_END, 0);
    CHECK(stub.n_draw == 1, "overflowed inline stream mixed with immediate rejects group");
    m(M_BEGIN_END, RSX_PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES);
    immediate_vertex(0,0,0,0); immediate_vertex(1,0,0,0);
    immediate_vertex(0,1,0,0);
    m(M_BEGIN_END, 0);
    CHECK(stub.n_draw == 2, "BEGIN recovers after mixed inline overflow");
    engine_down();
}

int main(void)
{
    vm_base = (u8*)calloc(1, GUEST_BYTES);
    if (!vm_base) { printf("[FAIL] guest memory\n"); return 1; }
    ppu_vm_size = GUEST_BYTES;
    /* Three vertices of float4 position, so the fetch has something real to
     * read: the engine treats an unreadable ATTR0 as a failed group. */
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 3 * 4; i++) {
        u8* p = vm_base + VTX_OFFSET + i * 4;
        p[0] = 0x3F; p[1] = 0x80; p[2] = 0; p[3] = 0;    /* 1.0f big-endian */
    }

    test_surface_set();
    test_surface_aliasing();
    test_mrt_set();
    test_texture_cache();
    test_texture_sparse_rehash();
    test_pipeline_key();
    test_restart_expansion();
    test_indexed_draws();
    test_scissor();
    test_readback();
    test_custom_guest_mapping();
    test_queued_flip_buffer();
    test_transfer_coherence();
    test_transfer_rows();
    test_transfer_reads_fp16();
    test_inline_array();
    test_depth_clear_value();
    test_antialiased_surface();
    test_depth_read_as_color();
    test_color_read_as_float();
    test_immediate_compositor();
    test_immediate_packed_zero_and_inline();

    free(vm_base);
    printf(g_failures ? "\n%d check(s) FAILED\n" : "\nall checks passed\n",
           g_failures);
    return g_failures ? 1 : 0;
}


===== FILE: \libs\video\tests\test_rsx_fifo.c =====
/*
 * ps3recomp - RSX FIFO parser test
 *
 * Verifies rsx_process_command_buffer: big-endian command-word decode and
 * method dispatch into the registered backend. This is the core of the
 * cellGcm -> RSX bridge (cellGcmSys's gcm_consume_fifo() just hands a
 * [get,put) slice of guest memory to this function).
 *
 * No D3D12: a tiny recording backend captures the dispatched calls.
 *
 * Build:
 *   gcc -std=c11 -O2 -I../../../include ../rsx_commands.c test_rsx_fifo.c -o t.exe
 */

#include "rsx_commands.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

/* --- recording backend ------------------------------------------------- */
static int      rec_clear_calls;
static u32      rec_clear_color;
static int      rec_blend_calls;
static int      rec_blend_enable;
static int      rec_draw_calls;
static u32      rec_draw_prim, rec_draw_first, rec_draw_count;

static void rb_clear(void* ud, u32 flags, u32 color, float depth, u8 stencil)
{ (void)ud;(void)flags;(void)depth;(void)stencil; rec_clear_calls++; rec_clear_color = color; }
static void rb_set_blend(void* ud, const rsx_state* s)
{ (void)ud; rec_blend_calls++; rec_blend_enable = s->blend_enable; }
static void rb_draw_arrays(void* ud, u32 prim, u32 first, u32 count)
{ (void)ud; rec_draw_calls++; rec_draw_prim = prim; rec_draw_first = first; rec_draw_count = count; }

static rsx_backend g_rec = {0};

/* --- big-endian FIFO writer -------------------------------------------- */
static u8  g_fifo[256];
static u32 g_fifo_len;

static void put_be32(u32 v)
{
    g_fifo[g_fifo_len++] = (u8)(v >> 24);
    g_fifo[g_fifo_len++] = (u8)(v >> 16);
    g_fifo[g_fifo_len++] = (u8)(v >> 8);
    g_fifo[g_fifo_len++] = (u8)(v);
}

/* One increasing method + single data word (count = 1). */
static void emit_method(u32 method, u32 data)
{
    u32 header = (1u << 18) | (((method >> 2) & 0x7FF) << 2); /* type 0, count 1 */
    put_be32(header);
    put_be32(data);
}

#define CHECK(cond, msg) do { \
    if (cond) { printf("[PASS] %s\n", msg); } \
    else { printf("[FAIL] %s\n", msg); failures++; } } while (0)

int main(void)
{
    int failures = 0;

    g_rec.clear        = rb_clear;
    g_rec.set_blend    = rb_set_blend;
    g_rec.draw_arrays  = rb_draw_arrays;
    rsx_set_backend(&g_rec);

    rsx_state st;
    rsx_state_init(&st);

    /* Build a small frame: set clear color, clear, enable blend, draw a tri. */
    emit_method(NV4097_SET_COLOR_CLEAR_VALUE, 0xAABBCCDD);
    emit_method(NV4097_CLEAR_SURFACE,         0xF);
    emit_method(NV4097_SET_BLEND_ENABLE,      1);
    emit_method(NV4097_SET_BEGIN_END,         RSX_PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES);
    emit_method(NV4097_DRAW_ARRAYS,           (2u << 24) | 0u); /* count 3, first 0 */
    emit_method(NV4097_SET_BEGIN_END,         0);

    int n = rsx_process_command_buffer(&st, (const u32*)g_fifo, g_fifo_len);

    printf("methods processed: %d\n", n);
    CHECK(n == 6, "all 6 methods dispatched");
    CHECK(rec_clear_calls == 1 && rec_clear_color == 0xAABBCCDD,
          "clear dispatched with correct color (BE decode)");
    CHECK(rec_blend_calls == 1 && rec_blend_enable == 1,
          "set_blend flushed on BEGIN_END with enable=1");
    CHECK(rec_draw_calls == 1 && rec_draw_prim == RSX_PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES &&
          rec_draw_first == 0 && rec_draw_count == 3,
          "draw_arrays dispatched (prim=5, first=0, count=3)");

    printf("\n===========================================\n");
    printf("Results: %s (%d failure(s))\n", failures ? "FAIL" : "OK", failures);
    return failures ? 1 : 0;
}

===== FILE: \libs\video\tests\test_rsx_primitives.c =====
/*
 * ps3recomp - self-contained tests for RSX primitive classification
 *
 *   cc -I include -I libs/video -o /tmp/t libs/video/tests/test_rsx_primitives.c && /tmp/t
 *
 * rsx_primitives.h is header-only, so there is nothing to link.
 *
 * This pins a truth table that three places in the tree previously answered
 * differently: the D3D12 backend (bare numbers), the Metal backend (its own
 * list), and a set of helpers in this header that nothing called. The two that
 * were live disagreed about LINE_LOOP and POLYGON.
 */
#include "rsx_primitives.h"

#include <stdio.h>

static int g_fail = 0;

#define CHECK(cond)                                                            \
    do { if (!(cond)) { printf("FAIL %s:%d  %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #cond); \
                        g_fail++; } } while (0)

#define CHECK_EQ(got, want)                                                    \
    do { long _g = (long)(got), _w = (long)(want);                             \
         if (_g != _w) { printf("FAIL %s:%d  %s = %ld, want %ld\n",            \
                                __FILE__, __LINE__, #got, _g, _w);             \
                         g_fail++; } } while (0)

/* Every primitive the RSX defines, and what each must come out as. Written as
 * a table so a disagreement is visible rather than buried in control flow. */
static const struct {
    u32          prim;
    const char*  name;
    int          expand;
    rsx_topology topo;
} k_expected[] = {
    { RSX_PRIMITIVE_POINTS,         "POINTS",         0, RSX_TOPOLOGY_POINTS         },
    { RSX_PRIMITIVE_LINES,          "LINES",          0, RSX_TOPOLOGY_LINES          },
    /* LINE_LOOP is a strip plus a closing edge. Neither backend draws that edge
     * yet, so it is NOT reported as needing expansion -- claiming otherwise
     * would promise work nobody does. */
    { RSX_PRIMITIVE_LINE_LOOP,      "LINE_LOOP",      0, RSX_TOPOLOGY_LINE_STRIP     },
    { RSX_PRIMITIVE_LINE_STRIP,     "LINE_STRIP",     0, RSX_TOPOLOGY_LINE_STRIP     },
    { RSX_PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES,      "TRIANGLES",      0, RSX_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLES      },
    { RSX_PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLE_STRIP, "TRIANGLE_STRIP", 0, RSX_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_STRIP },
    { RSX_PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLE_FAN,   "TRIANGLE_FAN",   1, RSX_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLES      },
    { RSX_PRIMITIVE_QUADS,          "QUADS",          1, RSX_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLES      },
    { RSX_PRIMITIVE_QUAD_STRIP,     "QUAD_STRIP",     1, RSX_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLES      },
    { RSX_PRIMITIVE_POLYGON,        "POLYGON",        1, RSX_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLES      },
};

static void test_truth_table(void)
{
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof k_expected / sizeof k_expected[0]; i++) {
        int  e = rsx_primitive_needs_expansion(k_expected[i].prim);
        rsx_topology t = rsx_primitive_topology(k_expected[i].prim);
        if (e != k_expected[i].expand)
            { printf("FAIL %s: needs_expansion = %d, want %d\n",
                     k_expected[i].name, e, k_expected[i].expand); g_fail++; }
        if (t != k_expected[i].topo)
            { printf("FAIL %s: topology = %d, want %d\n",
                     k_expected[i].name, (int)t, (int)k_expected[i].topo); g_fail++; }
    }
}

/* The contract between the two functions: if a primitive needs expanding, the
 * expansion produces a triangle list, so its topology MUST be TRIANGLES.
 * Anything else would have a backend expand into one topology and then draw
 * with another. */
static void test_expansion_implies_triangles(void)
{
    for (u32 p = 0; p < 16; p++)
        if (rsx_primitive_needs_expansion(p))
            CHECK_EQ(rsx_primitive_topology(p), RSX_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLES);
}

/* Nothing outside the defined range may claim to be drawable: an unknown
 * primitive that reported TRIANGLES would be silently drawn as garbage rather
 * than skipped. */
static void test_unknown_is_unsupported(void)
{
    CHECK_EQ(rsx_primitive_topology(0),   RSX_TOPOLOGY_UNSUPPORTED);
    CHECK_EQ(rsx_primitive_topology(11),  RSX_TOPOLOGY_UNSUPPORTED);
    CHECK_EQ(rsx_primitive_topology(255), RSX_TOPOLOGY_UNSUPPORTED);
    CHECK(!rsx_primitive_needs_expansion(0));
    CHECK(!rsx_primitive_needs_expansion(11));
    CHECK(!rsx_primitive_needs_expansion(255));
}

/* UNSUPPORTED must stay 0: the D3D12 backend's legacy path tests the returned
 * topology for falsity to decide whether it can draw at all. */
static void test_unsupported_is_zero(void)
{
    CHECK_EQ(RSX_TOPOLOGY_UNSUPPORTED, 0);
}

int main(void)
{
    test_truth_table();
    test_expansion_implies_triangles();
    test_unknown_is_unsupported();
    test_unsupported_is_zero();

    if (g_fail) { printf("\nRSX primitives: %d FAILED\n", g_fail); return 1; }
    printf("RSX primitive tests: all passed\n");
    return 0;
}

 CHECK(rsx_texture_gamma_mask(0x85,0xAAE4,1u<<29,15u<<20)==14,"signed source R wins over gamma R");

}


===== FILE: \libs\video\tests\test_rsx_texture_offset.c =====
/*
 * ps3recomp - texture offsets are 31 bits
 *
 * NV4097_SET_TEXTURE_OFFSET (0x1A00 + unit*0x20) and the vertex
 * texture offset (0x0900 + unit*0x20) carry a 31-bit offset; bit 31 is not an
 * address bit (RPCS3 masks it in RSXTexture.cpp offset()). A title binding a
 * main-memory plane as 0x82A22900 / 0x82B74100 got an IO lookup that missed
 * and a texture read from unwritten memory when the offset was decoded whole.
 *
 * Dispatcher only: no GPU, no host graphics API.
 *   gcc -std=gnu17 -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -I include -I libs/video \
 *       -o /tmp/test_rsx_texture_offset libs/video/tests/test_rsx_texture_offset.c \
 *       libs/video/rsx_dispatch.c
 */
#include "rsx_dispatch.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

static int g_failures;

#define CHECK(cond, ...)                                                      \
    do {                                                                      \
        if (cond) {                                                           \
            printf("[PASS] " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n");                      \
        } else {                                                              \
            printf("[FAIL] " __VA_ARGS__);                                    \
            printf("   (%s:%d)\n", __FILE__, __LINE__);                       \
            g_failures++;                                                     \
        }                                                                     \
    } while (0)

int main(void)
{
    rsx_dispatch_sink sink = {0};
    rsx_dispatch* rsx = (rsx_dispatch*)calloc(1, sizeof(rsx_dispatch));
    rsx_dispatch_init(rsx, &sink);

    /* Fragment unit 2 with bit 31 set: main memory (format & 3 == 2), 8-bit plane. */
    rsx_dispatch_method(rsx, 0x1A00 + 2 * 0x20, 0x82A22900u);
    rsx_dispatch_method(rsx, 0x1A04 + 2 * 0x20, 0x00018102u);
    rsx_dsp_texture t;
    rsx_dsp_get_texture(rsx, 2, &t);
    CHECK(t.offset == 0x02A22900u, "fragment unit 2 offset 0x82A22900 decodes to 0x02A22900 (got 0x%08X)", t.offset);
    CHECK(t.location == RSX_LOCATION_MAIN, "fragment unit 2 location stays main memory (got %u)", t.location);

    /* The other swap buffer, and a local-memory unit whose offset has bit 31 clear: unchanged. */
    rsx_dispatch_method(rsx, 0x1A00 + 2 * 0x20, 0x82B74100u);
    rsx_dsp_get_texture(rsx, 2, &t);
    CHECK(t.offset == 0x02B74100u, "fragment unit 2 offset 0x82B74100 decodes to 0x02B74100 (got 0x%08X)", t.offset);
    rsx_dispatch_method(rsx, 0x1A00, 0x0438000u);
    rsx_dispatch_method(rsx, 0x1A04, 0x00018101u);
    rsx_dsp_get_texture(rsx, 0, &t);
    CHECK(t.offset == 0x0438000u && t.location == RSX_LOCATION_LOCAL,
          "fragment unit 0 local offset 0x00438000 unchanged (got 0x%08X loc %u)", t.offset, t.location);

    /* Vertex texture unit 1 with bit 31 set. */
    rsx_dispatch_method(rsx, 0x0900 + 1 * 0x20, 0x80100000u);
    rsx_dispatch_method(rsx, 0x0904 + 1 * 0x20, 0x00018102u);
    rsx_dsp_vertex_texture vt;
    rsx_dsp_get_vertex_texture(rsx, 1, &vt);
    CHECK(vt.offset == 0x00100000u, "vertex unit 1 offset 0x80100000 decodes to 0x00100000 (got 0x%08X)", vt.offset);

    free(rsx);
    if (g_failures) { printf("%d check(s) FAILED\n", g_failures); return 1; }
    printf("all checks passed\n");
    return 0;
}


===== FILE: \libs\video\tests\test_rsx_transform_constants.c =====
/*
 * ps3recomp - SET_TRANSFORM_CONSTANT window test
 *
 * NV4097_SET_TRANSFORM_CONSTANT is a 32-dword window, 0x1F00..0x1F7C (eight
 * vec4s starting at TRANSFORM_CONSTANT_LOAD). The methods after it are
 * registers, not more constants: 0x1FD8 INVALIDATE_L2, 0x1FF0
 * VERTEX_ATTRIB_INPUT_MASK, 0x1FF8 TRANSFORM_BRANCH_BITS. Taking the window as
 * 64 dwords made each of those overwrite a constant c(load+8..15).
 *
 * Build (standalone):
 *   cc -std=c11 -I include -I libs/video libs/video/tests/test_rsx_transform_constants.c \
 *      libs/video/rsx_commands.c -o /tmp/test_rsx_transform_constants
 */
#include "rsx_commands.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

/* rsx_commands.c reaches the guest VM (semaphore labels, notify area), the
 * GCM IO map, its clock and the boot milestone log; nothing here uses any of
 * them, so stubs are enough to link. */
uint32_t ppu_hle_inject_base;
void vm_write32(uint32_t addr, uint32_t value) { (void)addr; (void)value; }
void ps3_ms(const char* key) { (void)key; }
uint32_t gcm_io_offset_to_ea(uint32_t io) { (void)io; return 0; }
unsigned long long ps3_ms_now(void) { return 0; }

static int g_fail;

static void check(int ok, const char* what)
{
    printf("[%s] %s\n", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL", what);
    if (!ok) g_fail = 1;
}

static u32 fbits(float f)
{
    u32 b;
    memcpy(&b, &f, 4);
    return b;
}

int main(void)
{
    rsx_state st;
    rsx_state_init(&st);

    const float k269 = 3.5f, k271 = -7.25f, w263 = 42.0f;

    rsx_process_method(&st, NV4097_SET_TRANSFORM_CONSTANT_LOAD, 269);
    rsx_process_method(&st, NV4097_SET_TRANSFORM_CONSTANT + 2 * 4, fbits(k269));   /* c269.z */
    rsx_process_method(&st, NV4097_SET_TRANSFORM_CONSTANT_LOAD, 271);
    rsx_process_method(&st, NV4097_SET_TRANSFORM_CONSTANT + 0 * 4, fbits(k271));   /* c271.x */
    check(st.vertex_constants[269][2] == k269 && st.vertex_constants[271][0] == k271,
          "constants seeded through the 0x1F00 window");

    /* load = 256: the old 64-dword window put 0x1FD8 on c269.z and 0x1FF0 on c271.x */
    rsx_process_method(&st, NV4097_SET_TRANSFORM_CONSTANT_LOAD, 256);
    check(rsx_process_method(&st, NV4097_INVALIDATE_L2, 0x12345678u) == 0,
          "INVALIDATE_L2 (0x1FD8) accepted");
    check(rsx_process_method(&st, NV4097_SET_VERTEX_ATTRIB_INPUT_MASK, 0x0000FFFFu) == 0,
          "VERTEX_ATTRIB_INPUT_MASK (0x1FF0) accepted");
    check(st.vertex_constants[269][2] == k269, "0x1FD8 with load=256 leaves c269.z alone");
    check(st.vertex_constants[271][0] == k271, "0x1FF0 with load=256 leaves c271.x alone");
    check(st.vertex_attrib_input_mask == 0x0000FFFFu, "0x1FF0 lands in vertex_attrib_input_mask");

    rsx_process_method(&st, 0x00001FC0u, 0x3u);
    rsx_process_method(&st, NV4097_SET_TRANSFORM_BRANCH_BITS, 0x81u);
    check(st.frequency_divider_op == 0x3u && st.transform_branch_bits == 0x81u,
          "0x1FC0/0x1FF8 land in their registers");

    rsx_process_method(&st, NV4097_SET_TRANSFORM_CONSTANT + 31 * 4, fbits(w263));  /* 0x1F7C */
    check(st.vertex_constants[263][3] == w263, "0x1F7C (last dword) still writes c263.w");

    printf("%s\n", g_fail ? "test_rsx_transform_constants: FAIL" : "test_rsx_transform_constants: PASS");
    return g_fail;
}


===== FILE: \libs\video\tests\test_shader_msl.c =====
/*
 * ps3recomp - guest shader -> MSL translation test
 *
 * Hand-assembles the smallest programs the Metal backend has to run (the
 * encoders live in rsx_test_programs.h, shared with the host harness),
 * pushes each through its decompiler, then through rsx_hlsl_to_msl, and
 * checks the MSL carries the bindings the backend depends on. Needs no GPU,
 * so it runs on Linux CI too -- which is the point: glslang's HLSL front end
 * and spirv-cross are checked against the decompilers' actual output on every
 * push, not only on the Mac that happens to have Metal.
 *
 * Programs:
 *   VP  MOV o0, v0 ; MOV o1, v3 (END)      position through, colour through
 *   FP  MOV r0, COL0 (END)                 colour out
 *   FP  MOV r0, COL0.zyxw (END)            colour out, red and blue swapped:
 *                                          what the host's --shader mode runs
 *   FP  MOV r0, -abs(COL1.zyxw) (END)      colour clamp before source modifiers
 *   FP  PK4UB r0, COL0 ; UPG r0, r0 (END)  pack to 8-bit, unpack sRGB->linear:
 *                                          what a character material does
 *   FP  TEX r0, TC0 unit 0 (END)           texture unit 0 sampled at texcoord0
 *   FP  TEX r0, TC0 unit 0, CUBE (END)     ... with unit 0 a cube map
 *   VP  MOV o0, v0 ; TXL o1, v8 (END)      a vertex texture sampled at t16
 *   FP  MOV r0, COL0 ; MOV r2, COL0.zyxw   two colour targets: what --mrt runs
 *
 * Each program's HLSL is checked for what was meant before the MSL is looked
 * at, so a wrong bit in an encoder shows up as a decompiler-level failure
 * rather than a mysterious MSL one.
 *
 * Built as a CMake target (test_shader_msl) because it links glslang and
 * spirv-cross. -v prints the HLSL and MSL of every program.
 */
#include "../rsx_vp_decompiler.h"
#include "../rsx_fp_decompiler.h"
#include "../rsx_shader_msl.h"
#include "../rsx_test_programs.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static int g_pass = 0, g_fail = 0, g_verbose = 0;

static void check(const char* what, const char* text, const char* needle)
{
    if (text && strstr(text, needle)) {
        printf("[PASS] %s -- found \"%s\"\n", what, needle);
        g_pass++;
    } else {
        printf("[FAIL] %s -- missing \"%s\"\n", what, needle);
        if (!g_verbose && text) printf("----\n%s\n----\n", text);
        g_fail++;
    }
}

static void check_absent(const char* what, const char* text, const char* needle)
{
    if (text && !strstr(text, needle)) {
        printf("[PASS] %s -- no \"%s\"\n", what, needle);
        g_pass++;
    } else {
        printf("[FAIL] %s -- found \"%s\"\n", what, needle);
        g_fail++;
    }
}

static void check_count(const char* what, int got, int want)
{
    if (got == want) { printf("[PASS] %s: %d instruction(s)\n", what, got); g_pass++; }
    else { printf("[FAIL] %s: decompile returned %d, expected %d\n", what, got, want); g_fail++; }
}

/* ---- the translation step, shared by every case -------------------------- */

static char g_hlsl[65536];
static char g_msl[65536];
static char g_log[4096];

static int translate(const char* what, int stage)
{
    if (g_verbose) printf("---- %s HLSL ----\n%s\n", what, g_hlsl);
    int rc = rsx_hlsl_to_msl(g_hlsl, stage, g_msl, sizeof g_msl, g_log, sizeof g_log);
    if (rc != 0) {
        printf("[FAIL] %s -- translation failed: %s\n", what, g_log);
        if (!g_verbose) printf("---- HLSL ----\n%s\n", g_hlsl);
        g_fail++;
        return -1;
    }
    printf("[PASS] %s -- translated (%u bytes of MSL)\n", what, (unsigned)strlen(g_msl));
    g_pass++;
    if (g_verbose) printf("---- %s MSL ----\n%s\n", what, g_msl);
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++)
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) g_verbose = 1;

    if (!rsx_hlsl_to_msl_available()) {
        printf("HLSL to MSL translation not built; nothing to test\n");
        return 2;
    }

    /* ---- vertex program: MOV o0, v0 ; MOV o1, v3 ------------------------- */
    {
        u8 vp[32];
        rsx_test_vp_mov_out(vp +  0, 0, RSX_TEST_VP_SWZ_IDENT, 0, 0);   /* MOV o0, v0 */
        rsx_test_vp_mov_out(vp + 16, 3, RSX_TEST_VP_SWZ_IDENT, 1, 1);   /* MOV o1, v3, END */

        check_count("VP", rsx_vp_decompile(vp, sizeof vp, g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl), 2);
        /* o0 takes v0 and o1 takes v3, unswizzled. */
        check("VP HLSL", g_hlsl, "(v[0]).xyzw");
        check("VP HLSL", g_hlsl, "o[0].xyzw = _v.xyzw;");
        check("VP HLSL", g_hlsl, "(v[3]).xyzw");
        check("VP HLSL", g_hlsl, "o[1].xyzw = _v.xyzw;");

        if (translate("VP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX) == 0) {
            check("VP MSL", g_msl, "vertex ");
            check("VP MSL", g_msl, "main0");
            /* The legalization pass drops inputs the program never reads,
             * so only v0 and v3 survive -- and v3 must still be attribute 3,
             * not renumbered to 1: the backend's vertex descriptor puts RSX
             * attribute i at offset i*16, used or not. */
            check("VP MSL", g_msl, "[[attribute(0)]]");
            check("VP MSL", g_msl, "[[attribute(3)]]");
            check("VP MSL", g_msl, "[[buffer(0)]]");      /* VPConst */
            check("VP MSL", g_msl, "[[position]]");
            check("VP MSL", g_msl, "[[user(locn0)]]");    /* COLOR0 */
            check("VP MSL", g_msl, "[[user(locn10)]]");   /* TEXCOORD7 */
        }
    }

    /* ---- fragment program: MOV r0, COL0 ---------------------------------- */
    {
        u8 fp[16];
        rsx_test_fp_mov_r0_col0(fp, RSX_TEST_FP_SWZ_IDENT);
        u32 nconst = 0;
        check_count("FP", rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_ex(fp, sizeof fp, 0x40u /* r0 exports */, 0,
                                                       g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, &nconst), 1);
        check("FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "(saturate(input.col0)).xyzw");
        check("FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "r[0].xyzw = _v.xyzw;");
        check("FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "cbuffer PSConstants : register(b1)");
        /* The alpha test patch must survive translation as well. */
        if (rsx_fp_apply_alpha_test_buffered(g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, 0x204u /* GREATER */) < 0) {
            printf("[FAIL] FP alpha test patch\n"); g_fail++;
        } else { printf("[PASS] FP alpha test patch\n"); g_pass++; }
        check("FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "fp_alpha.x");

        if (translate("FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0) {
            check("FP MSL", g_msl, "fragment ");
            check("FP MSL", g_msl, "main0");
            check("FP MSL", g_msl, "[[buffer(1)]]");      /* PSConstants */
            check("FP MSL", g_msl, "[[color(0)]]");
            check("FP MSL", g_msl, "[[user(locn0)]]");    /* COLOR0 from the VP */
            check("FP MSL", g_msl, "discard_fragment");
        }
    }

    /* ---- fragment program: MOV r0, COL0.zyxw (the host's --shader FP) ---- */
    {
        u8 fp[16];
        rsx_test_fp_mov_r0_col0(fp, RSX_TEST_FP_SWZ(2, 1, 0, 3));
        check_count("swizzled FP", rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_ex(fp, sizeof fp, 0x40u, 0,
                                                                g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, NULL), 1);
        check("swizzled FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "(saturate(input.col0)).zyxw");
        check("swizzled FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "r[0].xyzw = _v.xyzw;");
        if (translate("swizzled FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0)
            check("swizzled FP MSL", g_msl, "fragment ");
        /* No pack/unpack opcode, so none of the helpers: the text of a program
         * that does not use them is the same as before they existed. */
        check_absent("swizzled FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "_rsx_pk4ub");
    }

    /* ---- fragment program: PK4UB r0, COL0 ; UPG r0, r0 ---------------------
     * The pack/unpack pair a character material uses for its sRGB<->linear
     * conversion. The packed word is carried in r0's bits (asfloat), and the
     * unpack reads them back (asuint): the two must round-trip through
     * glslang and spirv-cross, which is where a bitcast can go wrong. */
    {
        u8 fp[32];
        rsx_test_fp_instr(fp,
                          RSX_TEST_FP_OPC(0x27 /* PK4UB */) | RSX_TEST_FP_MASK_XYZW |
                          RSX_TEST_FP_INSRC_COL0 | RSX_TEST_FP_OUTREG(0),
                          RSX_TEST_FP_SRC_INPUT | RSX_TEST_FP_SWZ_IDENT);
        rsx_test_fp_instr(fp + 16,
                          RSX_TEST_FP_OPC(0x2D /* UPG */) | RSX_TEST_FP_MASK_XYZW |
                          RSX_TEST_FP_OUTREG(0) | RSX_TEST_FP_END,
                          /* src0 reg_type 0 (temp), reg 0 */ RSX_TEST_FP_SWZ_IDENT);
        check_count("pack FP", rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_ex(fp, sizeof fp, 0x40u, 0,
                                                            g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, NULL), 2);
        check("pack FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "asfloat(_rsx_pk4ub((saturate(input.col0)).xyzw))");
        check("pack FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "_rsx_srgb2lin(_rsx_up4ub(((r[0]).xyzw).x))");
        check("pack FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "uint   _rsx_pk4ub(float4 v)");
        check("pack FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "float4 _rsx_srgb2lin(float4 cs)");
        if (translate("pack FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0) {
            check("pack FP MSL", g_msl, "fragment ");
            check("pack FP MSL", g_msl, "[[color(0)]]");
        }
    }

    /* ---- fragment program: MOV r0, -abs(COL1.zyxw) ------------------------
     * Clamp the interpolated colour before abs/negate: clamping a negated
     * colour instead would discard the negative result. DWORD1 bits 29 and
     * 17 are source abs and negate, respectively. */
    {
        u8 fp[16];
        rsx_test_fp_instr(fp,
                          RSX_TEST_FP_OPC(RSX_TEST_FP_OP_MOV) | RSX_TEST_FP_MASK_XYZW |
                          RSX_TEST_FP_INSRC(2) /* COL1 */ | RSX_TEST_FP_END,
                          RSX_TEST_FP_SRC_INPUT | RSX_TEST_FP_SWZ(2, 1, 0, 3) |
                          (1u << 29) /* abs */ | (1u << 17) /* negate */);
        check_count("modified COL1 FP",
                    rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_ex(fp, sizeof fp, 0x40u, 0,
                                                 g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, NULL), 1);
        check("modified COL1 FP HLSL", g_hlsl,
              "-(abs((saturate(input.col1)).zyxw))");
        if (translate("modified COL1 FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0) {
            check("modified COL1 FP MSL", g_msl, "fragment ");
            check("modified COL1 FP MSL", g_msl, "[[user(locn1)]]");
            check("modified COL1 FP MSL", g_msl, "[[color(0)]]");
        }
    }

    /* ---- fragment program: MOV r0, FACING ---------------------------------
     * Input 0xE is the face flag, +1 front / -1 back. Two-sided materials
     * multiply the normal by it; it used to read as zero. */
    {
        u8 fp[16];
        rsx_test_fp_instr(fp,
                          RSX_TEST_FP_OPC(RSX_TEST_FP_OP_MOV) | RSX_TEST_FP_MASK_XYZW |
                          RSX_TEST_FP_INSRC(0xE) | RSX_TEST_FP_END,
                          RSX_TEST_FP_SRC_INPUT | RSX_TEST_FP_SWZ_IDENT);
        check_count("FACING FP",
                    rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_ex(fp, sizeof fp, 0x40u, 0,
                                                 g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, NULL), 1);
        check("FACING FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "bool _rsx_front : SV_IsFrontFace;");
        check("FACING FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "input._rsx_front ? float4(1,1,1,1) : float4(-1,-1,-1,-1)");
        if (translate("FACING FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0)
            check("FACING FP MSL", g_msl, "[[front_facing]]");
    }

    /* ---- fragment program: MOV r0, TC8 / TC9 ------------------------------
     * They follow TEXCOORD7 (locn10), and the VP writes them from o15 / o6. */
    for (u32 n = 8; n <= 9; n++) {
        u8 fp[16];
        rsx_test_fp_instr(fp,
                          RSX_TEST_FP_OPC(RSX_TEST_FP_OP_MOV) | RSX_TEST_FP_MASK_XYZW |
                          RSX_TEST_FP_INSRC(0xC + (n - 8)) | RSX_TEST_FP_END,
                          RSX_TEST_FP_SRC_INPUT | RSX_TEST_FP_SWZ_IDENT);
        check_count("TC8/9 FP",
                    rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_ex(fp, sizeof fp, 0x40u, 0,
                                                 g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, NULL), 1);
        check("TC8/9 FP HLSL", g_hlsl, n == 8 ? "(input.tc8).xyzw" : "(input.tc9).xyzw");
        check("TC8/9 FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "float4 tc8:TEXCOORD8; float4 tc9:TEXCOORD9;");
        if (translate("TC8/9 FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0)
            check("TC8/9 FP MSL", g_msl, n == 8 ? "[[user(locn11)]]" : "[[user(locn12)]]");
    }
    {
        u8 vp[16];
        rsx_test_vp_mov_out(vp, 0, RSX_TEST_VP_SWZ_IDENT, 15, 1);   /* MOV o15, v0, END */
        rsx_vp_decompile(vp, sizeof vp, g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl);
        check("TC8 VP HLSL", g_hlsl, "Out.t8=o[15]; Out.t9=o[6];");
        if (translate("TC8 VP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX) == 0)
            check("TC8 VP MSL", g_msl, "[[user(locn11)]]");
    }

    /* ---- fragment program: TEX r0, TC0 (unit 0) --------------------------- */
    {
        u8 fp[16];
        rsx_test_fp_tex_r0_tc0(fp, 0);
        check_count("TEX FP", rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_ex(fp, sizeof fp, 0x40u, 0,
                                                           g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, NULL), 1);
        check("TEX FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "rsx_tex[0].Sample(rsx_samp[0]");
        /* Colour input clamping must not affect texture coordinates. */
        check("TEX FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "(input.tc0).xyzw");
        check("TEX FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "r[0].xyzw = _v.xyzw;");

        if (translate("TEX FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0) {
            check("TEX FP MSL", g_msl, "[[texture(0)]]");
            check("TEX FP MSL", g_msl, "[[sampler(0)]]");
            check("TEX FP MSL", g_msl, "[[user(locn3)]]");    /* TEXCOORD0 */
        }
    }

    /* ---- vertex program sampling a VERTEX TEXTURE ------------------------
     * MOV o0, v0 ; TXL o1, v8 on vertex-texture unit 0 (END). A transform
     * program that samples is how a title places instances or displaces a
     * mesh, and the point of the case is the binding slot: the decompiler
     * declares the unit at HLSL register t16, and the backend binds it with
     * setVertexTexture at index 16, so what has to hold is that spirv-cross
     * carries that register number into the vertex function rather than
     * renumbering it from zero. */
    {
        u8 vp[32];
        rsx_test_vp_mov_out(vp +  0, 0, RSX_TEST_VP_SWZ_IDENT, 0, 0);
        rsx_test_vp_txl_out(vp + 16, 8, RSX_TEST_VP_SWZ_IDENT, 0, 1, 1);

        check_count("vtex VP",
                    rsx_vp_decompile_ex(vp, sizeof vp, 1u /* unit 0 bound */,
                                        g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl), 2);
        check("vtex VP HLSL", g_hlsl, "Texture2D rsx_vtex0 : register(t16);");
        check("vtex VP HLSL", g_hlsl, "rsx_vtex0.SampleLevel(rsx_vsamp0,");

        if (translate("vtex VP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX) == 0) {
            check("vtex VP MSL", g_msl, "[[texture(16)]]");
            /* The sampler does NOT follow the texture's number: the
             * decompiler declares rsx_vsampN at register(sN), so unit 0's
             * sampler is [[sampler(0)]] while its texture is [[texture(16)]].
             * The backend binds them at those two different indices. */
            check("vtex VP MSL", g_msl, "[[sampler(0)]]");
        }

        /* Unmasked, the same program keeps its defined-zero fallback and
         * declares no texture at all -- which is why the mask has to be part
         * of the vertex program's cache key. */
        check_count("vtex VP unmasked",
                    rsx_vp_decompile(vp, sizeof vp, g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl), 2);
        if (strstr(g_hlsl, "rsx_vtex0")) {
            printf("[FAIL] vtex VP unmasked -- declared rsx_vtex0 with no unit bound\n");
            g_fail++;
        } else {
            printf("[PASS] vtex VP unmasked -- no texture declared\n");
            g_pass++;
        }
    }

    /* ---- fragment program: TEX r0, TC0 on a CUBE unit --------------------
     * The same program, decompiled with unit 0 marked as a cube map. The
     * declaration and the sample both have to change: a cube is looked up
     * with a 3-component direction, not a 2D coordinate, and the backend
     * binds an MTLTextureTypeCube to that slot -- Metal rejects a 2D texture
     * bound where the shader declared a texturecube, so a mask that did not
     * survive translation would be a validation failure rather than a wrong
     * pixel. */
    {
        u8 fp[16];
        rsx_test_fp_tex_r0_tc0(fp, 0);
        check_count("cube TEX FP",
                    rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_ex(fp, sizeof fp, 0x40u,
                                                 1u /* unit 0 is a cube */,
                                                 g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, NULL), 1);
        check("cube TEX FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "TextureCube rsx_tex0 : register(t0);");
        check("cube TEX FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "rsx_tex0.Sample(rsx_samp[0]");

        if (translate("cube TEX FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0) {
            check("cube TEX FP MSL", g_msl, "texturecube");
            check("cube TEX FP MSL", g_msl, "[[texture(0)]]");
            check("cube TEX FP MSL", g_msl, "[[sampler(0)]]");
        }
    }

    /* ---- fragment program: TEX r0, TC0 on a 3D unit ------------------------
     * A volume texture (SET_TEXTURE_FORMAT dimension 3): Texture3D in HLSL,
     * texture3d in MSL, sampled with three coordinates -- inFAMOUS 2's
     * occlusion volumes look their 8x8x8 cone LUT up this way. */
    {
        u8 fp[16];
        rsx_test_fp_tex_r0_tc0(fp, 0);
        check_count("3D TEX FP",
                    rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_shadow_color_expand_vol_ex(fp, sizeof fp, 0x40u,
                        0, 1u /* unit 0 is 3D */, NULL, NULL, NULL, g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, NULL), 1);
        check("3D TEX FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "Texture3D   rsx_tex0 : register(t0);");
        check("3D TEX FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "rsx_tex0.Sample(rsx_samp[0]");
        if (translate("3D TEX FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0)
            check("3D TEX FP MSL", g_msl, "texture3d");
    }

    /* ---- fragment program: TEX r0, TC0 with EXP_TEX on a biased unit -----
     * The _bx2 fetch: the lanes the unit's biased remap names come back as
     * x*2-1. The helper must survive glslang/spirv-cross intact. */
    {
        u8 fp[16];
        u8 expand[16] = {0};
        expand[0] = 0x7;
        rsx_test_fp_instr(fp, RSX_TEST_FP_OPC(RSX_TEST_FP_OP_TEX) | RSX_TEST_FP_MASK_XYZW |
                              RSX_TEST_FP_INSRC_TC0 | RSX_TEST_FP_TEXU(0) | (1u << 21) | RSX_TEST_FP_END,
                              RSX_TEST_FP_SRC_INPUT | RSX_TEST_FP_SWZ_IDENT);
        check_count("expand TEX FP", rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_shadow_color_expand_ex(fp, sizeof fp, 0x40u, 0,
                        NULL, NULL, expand, g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, NULL), 1);
        check("expand TEX FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "_rsx_expand_input(rsx_tex[0].Sample(rsx_samp[0], ((input.tc0).xyzw).xy), 15u, true)");
        if (translate("expand TEX FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0)
            check("expand TEX FP MSL", g_msl, "* 2.0");
    }

    /* ---- fragment program: TEX r0, TC0 with perspective_corr --------------
     * SRC2 bit 31 scales the texcoord by 1/w. Through glslang SV_POSITION.w
     * becomes FragCoord.w, which is already 1/w, so the helper must resolve
     * to the bare .w here (RSX_FRAGCOORD_W_IS_RCP) -- a division would undo
     * the correction and inFAMOUS 2's river would sample outside its copy. */
    {
        u8 fp[16];
        rsx_test_fp_tex_r0_tc0(fp, 0);
        rsx_test_fp_put_word(fp + 12, 1u << 31);
        check_count("persp TEX FP", rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_ex(fp, sizeof fp, 0x40u, 0,
                                                                 g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, NULL), 1);
        check("persp TEX FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "(input.tc0 * _rsx_inv_w(input.position))");
        if (translate("persp TEX FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0) {
            check("persp TEX FP MSL", g_msl, "gl_FragCoord.w");
            check_absent("persp TEX FP MSL", g_msl, "1.0 / gl_FragCoord.w");
        }
    }

    /* ---- fragment program writing TWO colour targets ---------------------
     * MOV r0, COL0 ; MOV r2, COL0.zyxw (END). With 32-bit exports r0 is
     * target A and r2 is target B, so the decompiler returns a struct of two
     * SV_TARGETs rather than one value. What has to hold on the way out is
     * that spirv-cross keeps them as [[color(0)]] and [[color(1)]] in that
     * order: the backend attaches the guest's MRT set in the set's own order,
     * and a pair that came back renumbered or collapsed would write the two
     * planes to the wrong surfaces with nothing to say so. This is the
     * program the host's --mrt mode draws with. */
    {
        u8 fp[32];
        rsx_test_fp_mrt_col0(fp, RSX_TEST_FP_SWZ_IDENT, RSX_TEST_FP_SWZ(2, 1, 0, 3));
        check_count("MRT FP", rsx_fp_decompile_buffered_ex(fp, sizeof fp, 0x40u, 0,
                                                           g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl, NULL), 2);
        check("MRT FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "float4 t0 : SV_TARGET0;");
        check("MRT FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "float4 t1 : SV_TARGET1;");
        check("MRT FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "PSOutput main(PSInput input) {");
        check("MRT FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "r[0].xyzw = _v.xyzw;");
        check("MRT FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "r[2].xyzw = _v.xyzw;");
        check("MRT FP HLSL", g_hlsl, "(saturate(input.col0)).zyxw");

        if (translate("MRT FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0) {
            check("MRT FP MSL", g_msl, "fragment ");
            check("MRT FP MSL", g_msl, "[[color(0)]]");
            check("MRT FP MSL", g_msl, "[[color(1)]]");
        }
    }

    /* ---- max/min/clamp/normalize come out as precise:: math ------------- *
     * spirv-cross writes them as fast::, whose NaN results Metal leaves
     * undefined; D3D's max/min return the number when one side is NaN, and
     * the guest programs rely on it. rsx_hlsl_to_msl respells them precise::
     * unless PS3RECOMP_MSL_FAST is set. */
    if (!getenv("PS3RECOMP_MSL_FAST")) {
        snprintf(g_hlsl, sizeof g_hlsl,
                 "float4 main(float4 c : COLOR0) : SV_TARGET0 {\n"
                 "    float3 n = normalize(c.xyz);\n"
                 "    return float4(max(n, c.www), min(c.w, 0.5)) * clamp(c.x, 0.1, 0.9);\n"
                 "}\n");
        if (translate("precise math FP", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT) == 0) {
            check("precise math FP MSL", g_msl, "precise::max");
            check("precise math FP MSL", g_msl, "precise::normalize");
            check_absent("precise math FP MSL", g_msl, "fast::");
        }
    }

    printf("\n%d passed, %d failed\n", g_pass, g_fail);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}


===== FILE: \libs\video\tests\test_shader_spirv.c =====
/*
 * ps3recomp - HLSL -> SPIR-V translation cache test
 *
 * rsx_hlsl_to_spirv keeps every translation it makes, in memory and, with
 * PS3RECOMP_SPIRV_CACHE=<dir>, on disk. This checks that:
 *   - the same stage and text is translated once, and the hit returns the
 *     same words;
 *   - the same text for another stage is its own entry;
 *   - a new process (simulated by rsx_hlsl_to_spirv_cache_reset) is served
 *     from the disk file, with the same words;
 *   - a damaged file is a miss, and is rewritten;
 *   - a failed translation is not cached;
 *   - a hit larger than the caller's buffer still fails as before.
 *
 * Built as a CMake target (test_shader_spirv) because it links glslang.
 * POSIX only (mkdtemp). Needs no GPU.
 */
#include "../rsx_shader_spirv.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static int g_pass = 0, g_fail = 0;

static void check(const char* what, int ok)
{
    printf("[%s] %s\n", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL", what);
    if (ok) g_pass++; else g_fail++;
}

static const char* kVS =
    "struct VOut { float4 pos : SV_Position; float4 col : COLOR0; };\n"
    "VOut main(float4 p : ATTR0, float4 c : ATTR3) {\n"
    "    VOut o; o.pos = p; o.col = c; return o;\n"
    "}\n";

static const char* kPS =
    "float4 main(float4 pos : SV_Position, float4 col : COLOR0) : SV_Target0 {\n"
    "    return col.zyxw;\n"
    "}\n";

/* Valid as either stage: no inputs, one output. */
static const char* kBoth =
    "float4 main() : SV_Target0 { return float4(1, 0, 0, 1); }\n";

#define MAX_WORDS 4096u
static u32 g_a[MAX_WORDS], g_b[MAX_WORDS];

static int translate(const char* hlsl, int stage, u32* words, u32* n)
{
    char log[512] = "";
    int r = rsx_hlsl_to_spirv(hlsl, stage, words, MAX_WORDS, n, log, sizeof log);
    if (r) printf("       (%s)\n", log);
    return r;
}

static RsxSpirvCacheStats stats(void)
{
    RsxSpirvCacheStats s;
    rsx_hlsl_to_spirv_cache_stats(&s);
    return s;
}

/* The one .spv file in dir, or "" when there is not exactly one. */
static void only_file(const char* dir, char* out, size_t size)
{
    DIR* d = opendir(dir);
    int n = 0;
    out[0] = 0;
    if (!d) return;
    struct dirent* e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        size_t len = strlen(e->d_name);
        if (len > 4 && strcmp(e->d_name + len - 4, ".spv") == 0) {
            snprintf(out, size, "%s/%s", dir, e->d_name);
            n++;
        }
    }
    closedir(d);
    if (n != 1) out[0] = 0;
}

int main(void)
{
    u32 na = 0, nb = 0;
    RsxSpirvCacheStats s;

    if (!rsx_hlsl_to_spirv_available()) {
        printf("[FAIL] built without glslang\n");
        return 1;
    }
    unsetenv("PS3RECOMP_SPIRV_CACHE");
    rsx_hlsl_to_spirv_cache_reset();

    /* Memory. */
    check("vertex program translates", translate(kVS, RSX_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX, g_a, &na) == 0 && na > 5);
    check("SPIR-V magic", g_a[0] == 0x07230203u);
    check("same request again succeeds", translate(kVS, RSX_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX, g_b, &nb) == 0);
    check("... with the same words", na == nb && memcmp(g_a, g_b, na * 4u) == 0);
    s = stats();
    check("... served from memory, glslang ran once", s.translations == 1 && s.memory_hits == 1);

    check("fragment program translates", translate(kPS, RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT, g_b, &nb) == 0);
    check("... with other words", na != nb || memcmp(g_a, g_b, na * 4u) != 0);

    check("same text as a vertex program", translate(kBoth, RSX_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX, g_a, &na) == 0);
    check("same text as a fragment program", translate(kBoth, RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT, g_b, &nb) == 0);
    s = stats();
    check("... two entries, not a hit", s.translations == 4 && s.memory_hits == 1);
    check("... with other words", na != nb || memcmp(g_a, g_b, na * 4u) != 0);

    {
        u32 small[4], n = 123;
        int r = rsx_hlsl_to_spirv(kPS, RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT, small, 4, &n, NULL, 0);
        check("a hit larger than the buffer fails", r == -1 && n == 0);
    }

    check("broken HLSL fails", translate("float4 main( {", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT, g_a, &na) != 0);
    check("... and again (not cached)", translate("float4 main( {", RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT, g_a, &na) != 0);
    s = stats();
    check("... counted as no translation", s.translations == 4);

    /* Disk. */
    char dir[] = "/tmp/ps3recomp_spirv_cache_XXXXXX";
    if (!mkdtemp(dir)) { printf("[FAIL] mkdtemp\n"); return 1; }
    setenv("PS3RECOMP_SPIRV_CACHE", dir, 1);
    rsx_hlsl_to_spirv_cache_reset();

    check("disk: first run translates", translate(kPS, RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT, g_a, &na) == 0);
    s = stats();
    check("... with glslang", s.translations == 1 && s.disk_hits == 0);
    char path[1024];
    only_file(dir, path, sizeof path);
    check("... and writes one file", path[0] != 0);

    rsx_hlsl_to_spirv_cache_reset();
    check("disk: next run succeeds", translate(kPS, RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT, g_b, &nb) == 0);
    s = stats();
    check("... from the file, no glslang", s.disk_hits == 1 && s.translations == 0);
    check("... with the same words", na == nb && memcmp(g_a, g_b, na * 4u) == 0);
    translate(kPS, RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT, g_b, &nb);
    s = stats();
    check("... then from memory", s.memory_hits == 1 && s.disk_hits == 1);

    /* Damage the stored key: the file no longer matches the request. */
    if (path[0]) {
        FILE* f = fopen(path, "r+b");
        if (f) { fseek(f, 13 * 4 + 10, SEEK_SET); fputc('#', f); fclose(f); }
    }
    rsx_hlsl_to_spirv_cache_reset();
    check("disk: damaged file still succeeds", translate(kPS, RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT, g_b, &nb) == 0);
    s = stats();
    check("... as a miss, with glslang", s.disk_hits == 0 && s.translations == 1);
    check("... with the same words", na == nb && memcmp(g_a, g_b, na * 4u) == 0);
    rsx_hlsl_to_spirv_cache_reset();
    translate(kPS, RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT, g_b, &nb);
    s = stats();
    check("... and the file was rewritten", s.disk_hits == 1 && s.translations == 0);

    /* A truncated file. */
    if (path[0] && truncate(path, 20) == 0) {
        rsx_hlsl_to_spirv_cache_reset();
        check("disk: truncated file still succeeds", translate(kPS, RSX_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT, g_b, &nb) == 0);
        s = stats();
        check("... as a miss", s.disk_hits == 0 && s.translations == 1);
    } else {
        check("truncate", 0);
    }

    only_file(dir, path, sizeof path);
    if (path[0]) remove(path);
    rmdir(dir);

    printf("\n%d passed, %d failed\n", g_pass, g_fail);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}

/* Synthetic production draw-engine shadow state/cache test; no title data. */

 texture(0,0xB0,2,1,7,0x01010000,0x80000000);draw_triangle();CHECK(stub.bound_pipeline==raw&&stub.n_pipeline_create==7,"second raw endpoint reuses ordinary shader");texture(0,0xB0,2,1,3,0x01010000,0x80000000);draw_triangle();CHECK(stub.bound_pipeline==h[3]&&stub.n_pipeline_create==7,"switchback selects correct comparison shader");
